WITH DepartmentEnrolledStudents AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC), EngineeringEECS_Courses AS (SELECT t0.COURSE, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.total_enrolled_students, ecc.COURSE, ecc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ecc.SCHOOL_NAME, ecc.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrolledStudents AS des JOIN EngineeringEECS_Courses AS ecc ON des.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ecc.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY des.total_enrolled_students DESC, ecc.COURSE
WITH OrgSpaceWindow AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t0.DLC_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT t0.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250')), OrgDlcStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT d.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND o.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'ADMISSIONS' AND NOT o.ORGANIZATION_ID IN ('138', '250') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.DESCRIPTION, ows.SPACE_UNIT, ows.window_column, ods.organization_count, ods.min_organization_number FROM OrgSpaceWindow AS ows JOIN OrgDlcStats AS ods ON ows.DLC_KEY = ods.DLC_KEY AND ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ods.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ows.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ows.SPACE_UNIT
WITH CourseMaxCIP AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_program_code, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING NOT MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) IS NULL), DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS std ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = std.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT cmc.COURSE, cmc.max_cip_program_code, cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dse.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrollment FROM CourseMaxCIP AS cmc JOIN DepartmentSubjectEnrollment AS dse ON cmc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE dse.total_enrollment > 100 ORDER BY dse.total_enrollment DESC
WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Peter' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), CourseInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.window_column AS student_window_min_dept_budget_code, ci.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ci.SUBJECT_TITLE, ci.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ci.SCHOOL_NAME AS course_school_name, ci.window_column AS course_window_dense_rank FROM StudentInfo AS si JOIN CourseInfo AS ci ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ci.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY si.LAST_NAME, ci.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptReservedMaterials AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10), ChemistrySubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N') SELECT drm.department_name, drm.total_reserved_materials, cs.SUBJECT_TITLE, cs.TERM_CODE, cs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cs.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, cs.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.max_enrolled_students FROM DeptReservedMaterials AS drm JOIN ChemistrySubjects AS cs ON drm.department_name = cs.join_dept_name ORDER BY drm.total_reserved_materials DESC, cs.max_enrolled_students DESC
WITH Subjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subjects2022WithTIP AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s2024.SUBJECT_CODE, s2024.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2024.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2024.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2024.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2024.window_column, s2024.SUBJECT_ID, s2024.TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_window_column, '2024_12Units' AS Reason FROM Subjects2024 AS s2024 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2022.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS window_column, s2022.SUBJECT_ID, s2022.TERM_CODE, s2022.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2022.window_column AS TIP_window_column, '2022_WithTIP' AS Reason FROM Subjects2022WithTIP AS s2022) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column, SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, TIP_window_column, Reason FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE, SUBJECT_ID
WITH SubjectDetails AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), StudentDepartmentDetails AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT sd.FIRST_NAME, sd.LAST_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.window_column AS student_window_column, sbd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sbd.TOTAL_UNITS, sbd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPARTMENT_NAME, sbd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sbd.window_column AS subject_window_column FROM StudentDepartmentDetails AS sd JOIN SubjectDetails AS sbd ON sd.DEPARTMENT = sbd.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY sd.FIRST_NAME, sbd.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH department_geometric_mean AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), eecs_subjects AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT egm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, egm.geometric_mean_enrolled_students, es.SUBJECT_ID, es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.subject_rank_in_department FROM department_geometric_mean AS egm JOIN eecs_subjects AS es ON egm.DEPARTMENT_CODE = es.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH top_departments AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY course_count DESC LIMIT 10), engineering_enrollment AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.SCHOOL_NAME, td.course_count, ee.total_enrolled FROM top_departments AS td LEFT JOIN engineering_enrollment AS ee ON td.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ee.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH DegreeGrantingCourses AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0), MathSubjects2014FA AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE_NUMBER = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), CombinedMathInfo AS (SELECT dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.total_degree_granting_courses, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms.window_column FROM DegreeGrantingCourses AS dgc JOIN MathSubjects2014FA AS ms ON dgc.SCHOOL_NAME = ms.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedMathInfo ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), RoomAndAvgPerFloor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, rapf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, rapf.ROOM_NUMBER, rapf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, rapf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM LargestRoomPerFloor AS lrf JOIN RoomAndAvgPerFloor AS rapf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = rapf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, rapf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
WITH MathSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.TERM_START_DATE, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows, c.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.TERM_CODE), MathFallLibraryAgg AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ms.TERM_CODE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.TERM_START_DATE, ms.max_total_units_3rows, mfla.min_academic_year, mfla.sum_total_units FROM MathSubjects AS ms LEFT JOIN MathFallLibraryAgg AS mfla ON ms.SUBJECT_ID = mfla.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.TERM_CODE
WITH SubjectUnits AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), GraduateStudents AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT su.SUBJECT_CODE, su.SUBJECT_NUMBER, su.DEPARTMENT_NAME, su.window_column, gs.total_graduate_students, ROUND(CAST(su.window_column AS REAL) / NULLIF(gs.total_graduate_students, 0), 2) AS normalized_running_sum FROM SubjectUnits AS su JOIN GraduateStudents AS gs ON su.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gs.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY normalized_running_sum DESC
WITH largest_room_per_floor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), room_and_avg_per_floor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM largest_room_per_floor AS lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC), MathSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrolled_students, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.window_column FROM DeptEnrolled AS d JOIN MathSubjects AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH DepartmentEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND tso.TERM_CODE IN ('2014FA', '2017JA') AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS + tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), MathSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrolled, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM, ms.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DepartmentEnrollment AS de JOIN MathSubjects AS ms ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND de.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.window_column
WITH MathSubjects2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SchoolCourseCounts AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, m.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.min_total_units_per_dept, scc.total_courses FROM MathSubjects2022 AS m LEFT JOIN SchoolCourseCounts AS scc ON m.SCHOOL_NAME = scc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_max_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units AS dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.avg_dept_budget_code, s2.max_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM subq1 AS s1 LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH MathSubjects2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE), MathDeptEnrolled AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.row_num_window, mde.total_enrolled FROM MathSubjects2022 AS ms JOIN MathDeptEnrolled AS mde ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mde.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH CourseDescAgg AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), TopMathCourses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cda.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cda.course_description_count, cda.min_cip_program_code FROM TopMathCourses AS tmc JOIN CourseDescAgg AS cda ON tmc.COURSE_NUMBER = cda.COURSE AND cda.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC
WITH MathDeptStats AS (SELECT s.TERM_CODE, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON s.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 12 AND (a.ACADEMIC_YEAR BETWEEN 2000 AND 2020 OR s.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) GROUP BY s.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s.TERM_CODE), PoliSciDeptStats AS (SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT mds.TERM_CODE, mds.min_academic_year, mds.avg_total_units, pds.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pds.TERM_START_DATE, pds.DEPARTMENT_CODE, pds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pds.subject_count, pds.total_enrollment FROM MathDeptStats AS mds JOIN PoliSciDeptStats AS pds ON mds.TERM_CODE = pds.TERM_CODE ORDER BY mds.TERM_CODE
WITH MaxEnrollmentPerDepartment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10), MathSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, m.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2024, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.window_column FROM MaxEnrollmentPerDepartment AS m JOIN MathSubjects2024 AS s ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s.window_column, s.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH dept_subjects_2021 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS num_subjects_offered, SUM(COALESCE(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, 0)) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND (d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) >= 5 ORDER BY num_subjects_offered DESC, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), eng_dept_enrollment AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ds21.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds21.SCHOOL_NAME, ds21.num_subjects_offered, ds21.total_enrolled_students, ede.total_enrolled FROM dept_subjects_2021 AS ds21 LEFT JOIN eng_dept_enrollment AS ede ON ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ede.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ds21.num_subjects_offered DESC, ds21.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH DepartmentStudentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), MathSubjects2022 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE, ms2022.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms2022.window_column FROM DepartmentStudentStats AS dss JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MathSubjects2022 AS ms2022 ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms2022.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms2022.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subject_summary AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), student_summary AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ss.window_column AS subject_window_rank, st.FIRST_NAME, st.LAST_NAME, st.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_department_name, st.STUDENT_YEAR, st.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, st.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, st.window_column AS student_window_avg_phone FROM subject_summary AS ss JOIN student_summary AS st ON ss.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = st.DEPARTMENT
WITH MathSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathDeptStudents AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), CombinedMathInfo AS (SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mds.student_count, mds.unique_student_years FROM MathSubjects2024 AS ms JOIN MathDeptStudents AS mds ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT * FROM CombinedMathInfo ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_CODE, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE
WITH math_subjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_max_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_subjects_max_units AS (SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dmu.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM dept_max_units AS dmu JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = dmu.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' ORDER BY dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.avg_dept_budget_code, d.max_total_units, d.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM math_subjects AS m JOIN dept_subjects_max_units AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) >= 100 ORDER BY total_enrolled_students DESC), MathCourseStats AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrolled_students, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.course_count, m.min_total_units FROM DeptEnrolled AS d JOIN MathCourseStats AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.COURSE_LEVEL
WITH subject_info AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_student_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT si.SUBJECT_ID, si.SUBJECT_CODE, si.SUBJECT_NUMBER, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, si.SUBJECT_TITLE, si.LECTURE_UNITS, si.LAB_UNITS, si.TOTAL_UNITS, si.GRADE_TYPE, si.GRADE_RULE, si.min_total_units_by_dept, ds.student_count, ds.unique_student_years FROM subject_info AS si LEFT JOIN dept_student_stats AS ds ON si.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND si.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY si.DEPARTMENT_CODE, si.SUBJECT_ID
WITH MathSubjects AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SchoolCourseCounts AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ms.COURSE_LEVEL, ms.SCHOOL_NAME, ms.min_total_units_per_dept, scc.total_courses FROM MathSubjects AS ms LEFT JOIN SchoolCourseCounts AS scc ON ms.SCHOOL_NAME = scc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH StudentInfo AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, msd.DEPARTMENT FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptEnrollment AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, de.total_enrolled FROM StudentInfo AS si LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON si.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptEnrollment AS de ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY si.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH DeptCourseCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1), DeptMaxEnroll AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.num_courses, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptCourseCounts AS dcc JOIN DeptMaxEnroll AS dme ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcc.num_courses DESC, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
WITH LargestRoomPerFloor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), RoomAveragesPerFloor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR FROM LargestRoomPerFloor AS lrf JOIN RoomAveragesPerFloor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE
WITH MathSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathGradStudentCounts AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgsc.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2024 AS ms JOIN MathGradStudentCounts AS mgsc ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), DeptYearStats AS (SELECT cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ds.num_unique_subjects, ds.min_total_units FROM MaxUnitsPerYear AS mu JOIN DeptYearStats AS ds ON mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ds.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, ds.num_unique_subjects DESC
WITH course_desc_stats AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top_math_courses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code FROM top_math_courses AS tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats AS cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code ORDER BY tmc.offer_count DESC
WITH PoliticalScienceGradStudents AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), PoliticalScienceSubjects AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT ps.FIRST_NAME, ps.LAST_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, pss.SUBJECT_ID, pss.SUBJECT_TITLE, pss.running_sum_total_units FROM PoliticalScienceGradStudents AS ps JOIN PoliticalScienceSubjects AS pss ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY ps.LAST_NAME, pss.SUBJECT_ID
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.max_total_units_3rows FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_CODE || '.' || s2.SUBJECT_NUMBER AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.TERM_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH TopStudentDepartments AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND (d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' OR d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '8') GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY student_count DESC LIMIT 10), TopSubjectDepartments AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT tsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tsd.SCHOOL_NAME, tsd.student_count, tsd2.subject_count FROM TopStudentDepartments AS tsd JOIN TopSubjectDepartments AS tsd2 ON tsd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tsd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND tsd.SCHOOL_NAME = tsd2.SCHOOL_NAME AND tsd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tsd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY tsd.student_count DESC
WITH TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(scd.COURSE) AS total_degree_granting_courses, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.SCHOOL_CODE <> 'Z' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(scd.COURSE) > 0), DepartmentSubjectInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.total_degree_granting_courses, dsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dsi.SUBJECT_TITLE, dsi.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, dsi.SCHOOL_NAME AS DEPT_SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column FROM TotalDegreeGrantingCourses AS t JOIN DepartmentSubjectInfo AS dsi ON t.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsi.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, dsi.window_column
WITH DeptYearEnrolledSubjects AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TopMathFallSubjects AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT d.department, d.academic_year, d.subject_count AS chem_bio_subject_count, d.min_term_start_date, t.subject_count AS math_fall_subject_count FROM DeptYearEnrolledSubjects AS d LEFT JOIN TopMathFallSubjects AS t ON d.academic_year = t.academic_year ORDER BY d.department, d.academic_year
WITH max_enrollment_2019fa AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10), max_enrollment_2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT m19fa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m19fa.SUBJECT_TITLE, m19fa.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, m19.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, m19.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM max_enrollment_2019fa AS m19fa JOIN max_enrollment_2019 AS m19 ON m19fa.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m19.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND m19fa.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m19.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH min_avg_student_year AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Economics' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT), dept_course_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.num_unique_courses, dcs.total_units, msy.MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, msy.AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM dept_course_stats AS dcs LEFT JOIN min_avg_student_year AS msy ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msy.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH DeptStudentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathSubjects2022 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SCHOOL_NAME, dss.student_count, dss.min_office_phone, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.window_column FROM DeptStudentStats AS dss JOIN MathSubjects2022 AS ms ON dss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH math_course_summary AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL), math_subjects_2005fa AS (SELECT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccc.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mcs.COURSE_LEVEL, mcs.course_count, mcs.min_total_units, ms2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms2.window_column FROM math_course_summary AS mcs JOIN math_subjects_2005fa AS ms2 ON mcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ms2.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sc.COURSE_LEVEL, sc.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_per_dept, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND sc.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' ORDER BY c.DEPARTMENT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.min_total_units_per_dept, NULL AS COURSE_NUMBER, NULL AS OFFER_COUNT, '12-unit 2022 Degree-Granting Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS min_total_units_per_dept, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.offer_count, 'Top 3 Most Frequently Offered Mathematics Course' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, COURSE_LEVEL, SCHOOL_NAME, min_total_units_per_dept, COURSE_NUMBER, OFFER_COUNT, Reason FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, MIN(e.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS e ON c.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID = e.MIT_ID WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT e.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE), PoliticalScienceCourseDescriptions AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, ssc.SCHOOL_NAME AS SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS COURSE_DEPT_NAME, scd.SCHOOL_NAME AS COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY scd.COURSE_LEVEL) AS course_level_dense_rank, scd.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = scd.COURSE WHERE NOT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pss.num_unique_subjects, pss.min_office_phone, pscd.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, pscd.SUBJECT_DEPT_NAME, pscd.SUBJECT_SCHOOL_NAME, pscd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, pscd.COURSE_DEPT_NAME, pscd.COURSE_SCHOOL_NAME, pscd.COURSE_LEVEL, pscd.course_level_dense_rank FROM PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS pss JOIN PoliticalScienceCourseDescriptions AS pscd ON pss.SUBJECT_CODE = pscd.COURSE ORDER BY pss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pscd.course_level_dense_rank
WITH GraduateMathStudents AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathSubjects2014FA AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.running_sum_enrolled_students, gms.total_graduate_students FROM MathSubjects2014FA AS ms JOIN GraduateMathStudents AS gms ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gms.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_ID
WITH PoliticalScienceStudents AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), PoliticalScienceSubjects AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, p.SUBJECT_ID, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, p.running_sum_total_units FROM PoliticalScienceStudents AS s JOIN PoliticalScienceSubjects AS p ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY s.LAST_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID
WITH MaxEnrollment AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10), MathSubjects2024 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT me.DEPARTMENT_NAME, me.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLL_SUBJECT_TITLE, me.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE AS SUBJECT_TITLE_2024, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.window_column FROM MaxEnrollment AS me JOIN MathSubjects2024 AS ms ON me.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.window_column
WITH dept_enrollment AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), math_fall_top10 AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT de.department, de.academic_year, de.subject_count AS chem_bio_subject_count, de.min_term_start_date, mft10.subject_count AS math_fall_subject_count FROM dept_enrollment AS de LEFT JOIN math_fall_top10 AS mft10 ON de.academic_year = mft10.academic_year ORDER BY de.department, de.academic_year
WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dte.total_enrolled_students DESC, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC

WITH OfferedMathSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathDeptSubjectCodeStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT oms.SUBJECT_ID, oms.SUBJECT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, oms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, oms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, oms.SUBJECT_TITLE, oms.LECTURE_UNITS, oms.LAB_UNITS, oms.TOTAL_UNITS, oms.GRADE_TYPE, oms.GRADE_RULE, oms.min_total_units_by_dept, mds.subject_code_count, mds.min_dept_budget_code FROM OfferedMathSubjects AS oms JOIN MathDeptSubjectCodeStats AS mds ON oms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mds.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND oms.SUBJECT_CODE = mds.SUBJECT_CODE AND oms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mds.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY oms.DEPARTMENT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_CODE, oms.SUBJECT_NUMBER

WITH student_info AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME), school_units_geom_mean AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT si.FIRST_NAME, si.LAST_NAME, si.EMAIL_ADDRESS, si.DEPARTMENT_NAME, si.STUDENT_YEAR, si.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, si.SCHOOL_NAME, si.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sugm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM student_info AS si LEFT JOIN school_units_geom_mean AS sugm ON si.SCHOOL_NAME = sugm.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY si.SCHOOL_NAME
