WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), TopDepartments AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear AS mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC
WITH DeptCourseCounts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 1), DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.GRADE_TYPE) SELECT dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcc.SCHOOL_NAME, dcc.num_courses, dss.GRADE_TYPE, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units FROM DeptCourseCounts AS dcc JOIN DeptSubjectStats AS dss ON dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dcc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.GRADE_TYPE
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), EECS_Subjects AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.total_enrolled, e.SUBJECT_TITLE, e.TOTAL_UNITS, e.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS EECS_DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, e.window_column FROM DeptEnrolled AS d JOIN EECS_Subjects AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = e.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.window_column
WITH dept_admin_stats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS department_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), math_subjects_2022 AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY s.HGN_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS avg_num_enrolled_students_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT das.DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, das.department_count, das.min_budget_code, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ms.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ms.avg_num_enrolled_students_window FROM dept_admin_stats AS das JOIN math_subjects_2022 AS ms ON das.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH DeptEnrolled AS (SELECT t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(su.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON t.TERM_CODE = so.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS su ON so.TERM_CODE = su.TERM_CODE WHERE t.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME <> 'Chemistry' GROUP BY t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(su.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), DeptMaxUnits AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), CombinedDepts AS (SELECT d1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, d1.total_enrolled, NULL AS max_total_units, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, 'Enrolled' AS Reason FROM DeptEnrolled AS d1 UNION ALL SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_enrolled, d2.max_total_units, d2.SCHOOL_NAME, 'MaxUnits' AS Reason FROM DeptMaxUnits AS d2) SELECT * FROM CombinedDepts ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH TopDepartments AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_courses DESC LIMIT 3), DepartmentGeometricMean AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_cip FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_cip DESC) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_CODE, td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.num_courses, dgm.geometric_mean_cip FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN DepartmentGeometricMean AS dgm ON td.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dgm.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY td.num_courses DESC, dgm.geometric_mean_cip DESC
WITH DeptMinAvg AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), DeptMaxEnrolled AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dminavg.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dminavg.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dminavg.min_num_enrolled_students, dminavg.avg_total_units, dmaxenr.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dmaxenr.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptMinAvg AS dminavg JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled AS dmaxenr ON dminavg.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dmaxenr.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY dminavg.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.TERM_CODE), Top10Depts AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC LIMIT 10), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), dept_avg AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MathDeptAgg AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled) SELECT t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term, m.COURSE_LEVEL, m.course_count, m.min_total_units FROM Top10Depts AS t LEFT JOIN MathDeptAgg AS m ON t.DEPARTMENT_NAME = m.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t.highest_unique_subjects_in_a_term DESC, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.COURSE_LEVEL
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS = inner_cte.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_count) AS max_admin_dept_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_LEVEL, i.course_count, i.min_total_units, d.SCHOOL_NAME, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > 12 THEN 'ABOVE_12' ELSE 'BELOW_12' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.max_admin_dept_count, s2.COURSE_LEVEL, s2.course_count, s2.min_total_units, s2.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.unit_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND UPPER(ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) <> 'MANAGEMENT' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, ic.num_distinct_courses), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_clearing_cost_collector, ic.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte2 AS ic) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL, s1.num_distinct_courses, s2.total_clearing_cost_collector, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.GRADUATE_LEVEL
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME), math_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sad.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR) AS total_clearing_cost_collector FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME), school_clearing_cost AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(total_clearing_cost_collector) AS highest_total_clearing_cost_collector FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT mc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mc.SCHOOL_NAME, mc.SUBJECT_CODE, mc.subject_course_count, scc.highest_total_clearing_cost_collector FROM math_courses AS mc JOIN school_clearing_cost AS scc ON mc.SCHOOL_NAME = scc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY mc.subject_course_count DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), CourseTotals AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_dept_budget_code, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ssc.SCHOOL_CODE = sd.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.SCHOOL_NAME, ic1.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE, ic2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic2.running_sum_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 LEFT JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON ic1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ic2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic2.running_sum_dept_budget_code > 200000 UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM CourseTotals AS ct ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.min_num_enrolled_students, ic.avg_dept_budget_code, cno.MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, cno.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER AS MOST_COMMON_COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(*) AS COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, tso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS cno ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cno.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cno.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT = (SELECT MAX(sub.COURSE_OFFER_COUNT) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS COURSE_OFFER_COUNT FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 ON tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ((tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) AND sd2.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE BETWEEN 90000 AND 200000 AND sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cno.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY tso2.COURSE_NUMBER) AS sub)), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.row_num_window, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(c2.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c2 WHERE c2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c2.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subj_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), mathematics_stats AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.subj_count AS mathematics_subject_code_count, AVG(i.subj_count) AS avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, (m.subj_count - AVG(i.subj_count)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN inner_cte1 AS m ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT_CODE, m.subj_count), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), zoe_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.unique_students > avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.unique_students < avg_stats.avg_unique_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(unique_students) AS avg_unique_students FROM inner_cte2) AS avg_stats) SELECT ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.mathematics_subject_code_count, ms.avg_subject_code_count_across_departments, ms.deviation_from_avg, zs.unique_students AS zoe_unique_students, zs.benchmark AS zoe_benchmark, zs.enrollment_category AS zoe_enrollment_category FROM mathematics_stats AS ms LEFT JOIN zoe_stats AS zs ON ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = zs.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ms.deviation_from_avg DESC, zs.unique_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte_1 AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), CourseTotals AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte_1 GROUP BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte_2 AS (SELECT MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, SUM(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS sum_lecture_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON a.TERM_CODE = c.TERM_CODE WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.admin_dept_dense_rank, NULL AS total_courses, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS sum_lecture_units, NULL AS num_unique_subjects, NULL AS term_description FROM inner_cte_1 AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL, NULL, NULL, ct.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, ct.total_courses, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL FROM CourseTotals AS ct UNION ALL SELECT NULL, a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL, NULL, NULL, NULL, inner_cte_2.min_total_units, inner_cte_2.sum_lecture_units, COUNT(DISTINCT a.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS a JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS b ON a.TERM_CODE = b.TERM_CODE CROSS JOIN inner_cte_2 WHERE a.TERM_CODE = '2021SP' AND a.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND a.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY a.DEPARTMENT_NAME, b.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte_2.min_total_units, inner_cte_2.sum_lecture_units ORDER BY SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_DESCRIPTION
WITH dept_subjects_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), math_letter_graded_2022 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t0.SUBJECT_TITLE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dse.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dse.subject_count, dse.total_enrolled_students, mlg.SUBJECT_TITLE, mlg.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS MATH_DEPT_NAME, mlg.TERM_DESCRIPTION, mlg.TOTAL_UNITS, mlg.window_column FROM dept_subjects_enrollment AS dse CROSS JOIN math_letter_graded_2022 AS mlg
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), subq1 AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) ORDER BY avg_total_units DESC) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER, s2.avg_total_units FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), avg_units_cte AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), filtered_subjects AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN avg_units_cte AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100), dept_enrollment_summary AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrolled) SELECT f.DEPARTMENT_CODE, f.DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.SUBJECT_CODE, f.SUBJECT_NUMBER, f.SUBJECT_TITLE, f.TOTAL_UNITS, f.window_column, d.total_enrolled, d.num_unique_subjects FROM filtered_subjects AS f JOIN dept_enrollment_summary AS d ON f.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY f.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH dept_highest_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS highest_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_subjects_2024 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION END AS term_description, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_stats.subject_count_in_dept, inner_cte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subject_count_in_dept FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.TERM_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_stats ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = dept_stats.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT m.term_description, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.highest_avg_enrollment, m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.subject_rank_in_dept, m.SCHOOL_NAME, m.subject_count_in_dept FROM math_subjects_2024 AS m LEFT JOIN dept_highest_avg_enrollment AS d ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY m.term_description, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.BUILDING_ROOM, fr.AREA, fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, fba.BUILDING_NUMBER FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 100 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fba.BUILDING_NUMBER = '32' AND fr.ORGANIZATION_NAME <> 'DP OF FACILITIES') SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER, fba.POSTAL_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NUMBER = fba.BUILDING_NUMBER), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fr.FLOOR, fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC, fr.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_FLOOR AS ff ON fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = ff.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY AND fr.FLOOR = ff.FLOOR WHERE fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND ff.ACCESS_LEVEL = 2 AND fr.MAJOR_USE_DESC NOT LIKE '%STORAGE%') SELECT ic.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.AREA, (ic.AREA - avg_floor_area.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT FLOOR, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR) AS avg_floor_area ON ic.FLOOR = avg_floor_area.FLOOR) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.BUILDING_NUMBER, s1.POSTAL_CODE, s1.row_num_window, s2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.AREA AS s2_AREA, s2.area_deviation_from_floor_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.BUILDING_NUMBER = s2.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.AREA
WITH math_admin_dept_rank AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(admin_dept_dense_rank) AS highest_admin_dept_dense_rank FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), top_departments_2022 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.subject_count, m.highest_admin_dept_dense_rank, ROUND(CAST(t.subject_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(m.highest_admin_dept_dense_rank, 0), 2) AS normalized_subjects_per_admin_dept_rank FROM top_departments_2022 AS t LEFT JOIN math_admin_dept_rank AS m ON t.SCHOOL_NAME = m.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t.SCHOOL_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - WITH geometric_mean_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics') SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte WHERE SCHOOL_NAME <> 'School of Science' GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), subject_count_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count FROM (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ranked WHERE rn <= 5 UNION ALL SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(subject_count) AS subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT scc.SCHOOL_NAME, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scc.subject_count, gmc.geometric_mean FROM subject_count_cte AS scc LEFT JOIN geometric_mean_cte AS gmc ON scc.SCHOOL_NAME = gmc.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY scc.SCHOOL_NAME, scc.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_units_above_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_units FROM inner_cte1 WHERE total_units > (SELECT AVG(total_units) FROM inner_cte1)), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_avg AS (SELECT t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dua.total_units, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - m.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg FROM dept_units_above_avg AS dua JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN inner_cte2 AS i ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = i.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN math_avg AS m ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dua.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column

BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), dept_avg2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), overall_avg2 AS (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS overall_avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science'), subq2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.dept_avg_units, (d.dept_avg_units - o.overall_avg_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_avg2 AS d CROSS JOIN overall_avg2 AS o) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.enrollment_category, s2.dept_avg_units, s2.deviation_from_overall_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
WITH dept_budget_deviation AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, (d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE - s.avg_dept_budget_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) AS s ON d.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL), eng_dept_max_phone AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS MAX_OFFICE_PHONE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE > 1000000000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, msd.FULL_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT AND msd.OFFICE_PHONE = inner_cte.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, d.deviation_from_avg, e.MAX_OFFICE_PHONE, e.FULL_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM dept_budget_deviation AS d LEFT JOIN eng_dept_max_phone AS e ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = e.department_name ORDER BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), school_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT t0.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS sub GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '6' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte2 AS ic JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ic.num_courses >= 5 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column, d.unique_course_titles FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN school_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN dept_courses AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > s.avg_units ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.window_column
WITH highest_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE, AVG(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment_per_term FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND NOT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, l.TERM_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_enrollment_per_term) AS highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME), course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_OPTION) AS distinct_course_options FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.COURSE_LEVEL = scd.COURSE_LEVEL GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_LEVEL, icte.course_count, icte.min_total_units, scd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.distinct_course_options, hae.highest_avg_enrollment_per_term FROM course_stats AS cs JOIN highest_avg_enrollment AS hae ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = hae.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), RoomCourseCounts AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' GROUP BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.AREA, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = t1.MEET_PLACE WHERE t0.AREA > 400 AND t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic1.BUILDING_ROOM, ic1.AREA, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic1.window_column, rcc.Total_Courses FROM inner_cte1 AS ic1 JOIN RoomCourseCounts AS rcc ON ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = rcc.FCLT_ROOM_KEY JOIN inner_cte2 AS ic2 ON ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = ic2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AND ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE = ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND ic1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ic2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND ic1.window_column = ic2.window_column ORDER BY ic1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, ic1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic1.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH math_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE WHERE c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.TERM_CODE), eng_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, s.TERM_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.TERM_START_DATE, at.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, MIN(inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE) SELECT m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.TERM_CODE, m.TERM_DESCRIPTION, m.max_total_units_3rows, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, e.TERM_START_DATE, e.TERM_END_DATE, e.window_column FROM math_cte AS m JOIN eng_cte AS e ON m.TERM_CODE = e.TERM_CODE ORDER BY m.SUBJECT_CODE, m.SUBJECT_NUMBER, m.TERM_CODE, e.SCHOOL_NAME, e.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH SchoolCIP AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS max_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.SCHOOL_CODE HAVING MAX(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) > 120000) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, MAX(i.max_cip_code) AS school_max_cip_code, CASE WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) > 150000 THEN 'HIGH_CIP' WHEN MAX(i.max_cip_code) < 130000 THEN 'LOW_CIP' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CIP' END AS cip_category, i.SCHOOL_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s ON i.SCHOOL_CODE = s.SCHOOL_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, i.SCHOOL_CODE), MathDeptTopSubject AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS subject_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SCHOOL_NAME = scd.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = ssc.SCHOOL_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ssc.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY subject_course_count DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT sc.SCHOOL_NAME, sc.SCHOOL_NAME_IN_COMMENCEMENT_BK, sc.school_max_cip_code, sc.cip_category, mdts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, mdts.SCHOOL_NAME AS MATH_SCHOOL_NAME, mdts.SUBJECT_CODE, mdts.subject_course_count FROM SchoolCIP AS sc LEFT JOIN MathDeptTopSubject AS mdts ON sc.SCHOOL_NAME = mdts.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sc.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, LSO.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS SSC ON SCD.COURSE = SSC.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS LSO ON SSC.COURSE_NUMBER = LSO.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE LSO.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND SCD.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Chemistry') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students, (MAX(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS)) AS enrolled_students_range FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME), PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(student_count))) AS geometric_mean_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS student_count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS m ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = m.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_CODE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_students) SELECT des.DEPARTMENT_NAME, des.avg_enrolled_students, des.enrolled_students_range, pss.SUBJECT_CODE, pss.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, pss.geometric_mean_students, pss.unique_student_years FROM DepartmentEnrollmentStats AS des JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON des.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN PoliticalScienceSubjectStats AS pss ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = pss.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY des.enrolled_students_range DESC, pss.geometric_mean_students DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(ic.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT ssc.SUBJECT_CODE) AS unique_subject_code_count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte) SELECT subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, subq1.unique_subject_code_count, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq2.total_courses FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subq2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Physics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 9 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.max_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS = icte.max_total_units AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, subject_count, total_enrollment FROM inner_cte WHERE total_enrollment > (SELECT AVG(total_enrollment) FROM inner_cte)) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s1.max_total_units, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.subject_count, s2.total_enrollment FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, COUNT(DISTINCT s.COURSE_NUMBER) AS unique_course_count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ic.SUBJECT_CODE = s.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) - MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS enrolled_range FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') AND NOT td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(enrolled_range) AS avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.subject_code_count, s1.min_dept_budget_code, s1.unique_course_count, s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE s2.avg_enrolled_range_per_subject > 0 ORDER BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH max_enrollment_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrollment, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING MAX(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 0) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_enrollment, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), avg_units_cte AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, avg_total_units, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte WHERE avg_total_units > (SELECT AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022)) SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.max_enrollment, m.SUBJECT_TITLE, m.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, a.avg_total_units FROM max_enrollment_cte AS m JOIN avg_units_cte AS a ON m.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY a.avg_total_units DESC

WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT c.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18'), math_dept_courses AS (SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, dept_course_counts.total_courses, ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 AS ic JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte1 WHERE NOT SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) >= 5) AS dept_course_counts ON ic.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME = dept_course_counts.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE), subjects_above_avg AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT mdc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mdc.SUBJECT_TITLE, mdc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, mdc.SCHOOL_NAME, mdc.total_courses, sa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sa.num_subjects_above_avg FROM math_dept_courses AS mdc LEFT JOIN subjects_above_avg AS sa ON mdc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sa.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY mdc.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sa.num_subjects_above_avg DESC
WITH school_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), math_course_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS total_courses FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE > 100000 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' GROUP BY scd.SCHOOL_NAME, scd.DEPARTMENT) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(total_courses) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte WHERE total_courses > (SELECT AVG(dept_course_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE) AS dept_course_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION GROUP BY DEPARTMENT) AS sub) GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(DEPT_BUDGET_CODE))) AS geometric_mean_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT WHERE IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' AND NOT DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_dept_budget_code) AS school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, AVG(dept_subject_counts.subject_count) AS avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = dept_subject_counts.SCHOOL_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY i.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.SCHOOL_NAME), CombinedSchools AS (SELECT s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.total_courses, s2.school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, s2.avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SCHOOL_NAME = s2.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, total_courses, school_geometric_mean_dept_budget_code, avg_subject_codes_per_department FROM CombinedSchools ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte1 AS (WITH student_counts AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS num_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.STUDENT_YEAR), dept_stats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(sc.num_students) AS avg_students_per_year FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN student_counts AS sc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = avg_students_per_year, DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM dept_stats), SchoolDeptCounts AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_degree_granting_departments FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), dept_zoe_stats AS (SELECT inner_cte2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.unique_students, avg_stats.avg_unique_students AS benchmark, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.unique_students > WITH admin_dept_enrollment AS (SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled FROM (SELECT sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 100) AS inner_cte WHERE total_enrolled > (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) FROM (SELECT sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad2 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 ON sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY sad2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_table)), dept_subjects_above_avg AS (SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS num_subjects_above_avg FROM (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7') AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7') AS inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE), combined AS (SELECT ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ade.total_enrolled, dsa.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsa.num_subjects_above_avg FROM admin_dept_enrollment AS ade JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON UPPER(ade.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = UPPER(sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) JOIN dept_subjects_above_avg AS dsa ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dsa.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_enrolled, DEPARTMENT_NAME, num_subjects_above_avg FROM combined ORDER BY num_subjects_above_avg DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY WITH inner_cte AS (WITH MaxUnitsPerYear AS (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION HAVING MAX(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6), TopDepartments AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR, td.subject_count, mu.max_total_units, mu.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM TopDepartments AS td JOIN MaxUnitsPerYear AS mu ON td.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mu.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY td.DEPARTMENT_NAME, td.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.max_total_units, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COALESCE(stc.unique_subject_titles, 0) AS unique_subject_titles_with_gt6_units FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS unique_subject_titles FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS stc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = stc.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND c.GRADE_TYPE = 'L' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, dmu.MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS MAX_TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2021FA' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '5' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(sos.SUBJECT_ID) > 0) AS dmu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(msd.OFFICE_PHONE) AS min_office_phone FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.student_count, icte.min_office_phone, cso.SUBJECT_CODE, cso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, subj_count.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN (SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN (SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Total_Subjects FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS subj_count ON cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = subj_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY cso.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), subq2 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, subq2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM subq1 LEFT JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, tip_subq.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_TIP, tip_subq.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME_TIP FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_TIP, tso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME_TIP FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS tip_subq ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tip_subq.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_degree_courses, AVG(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY total_degree_courses DESC LIMIT 10), DeptSubjects AS (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_rank_in_department, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '18' GROUP BY sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_degree_courses, icte.avg_cip_program_code, NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS subject_rank_in_department FROM inner_cte AS icte UNION ALL SELECT ds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS total_degree_courses, NULL AS avg_cip_program_code, ds.SUBJECT_ID, ds.SUBJECT_TITLE, ds.subject_rank_in_department FROM DeptSubjects AS ds WHERE ds.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM inner_cte)) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, total_degree_courses, avg_cip_program_code, SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, subject_rank_in_department FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_ID
