WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subject_max_units AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ccso.TOTAL_UNITS DESC, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS rn FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.subject_count, smu.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Max_Units_Subject, smu.TOTAL_UNITS AS Max_Subject_Units FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN subject_max_units AS smu ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = smu.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND smu.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, dept_subject_counts.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN (SELECT d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(sos2.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d2 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos2 ON d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d2.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS dept_subject_counts ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dept_subject_counts.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.window_column, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_dense_rank, cso.SUBJECT_DESCRIPTION, cso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND scd.SCHOOL_NAME = icte.SCHOOL_NAME AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' AND scd.DEPARTMENT = '18' JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE, admin_dept_dense_rank
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH min_avg_student_year AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') AND c.SUBJECT_CODE) AS num_unique_courses, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.num_unique_courses, dcs.total_units, msy.MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, msy.AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM dept_course_stats AS dcs LEFT JOIN min_avg_student_year AS msy ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msy.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.num_unique_courses, icte.total_units, icte.MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH course_desc_stats AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptBudgetStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY d.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), DeptEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME HAVING MAX(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT dbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbs.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dbs.SCHOOL_NAME, dbs.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dbs.avg_dept_budget_code, des.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, des.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM DeptBudgetStats AS dbs JOIN DeptEnrollmentStats AS des ON dbs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_dept_budget_code, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.MAX_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_ID, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY lso.SUBJECT_ID) AS running_sum_enrolled_students, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.TERM_CODE = cso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, lso.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.running_sum_enrolled_students, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY window_column DESC LIMIT 10

t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), WindowedEnrollment AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), StudentSubjects AS (SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, msd.FULL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.TERM_CODE, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'), StudentSubjectCounts AS (SELECT ss.FULL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM StudentSubjects AS ss GROUP BY ss.FULL_NAME) SELECT s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sc.subject_count, ss.SUBJECT_ID, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN StudentSubjectCounts AS sc ON s.FULL_NAME = sc.FULL_NAME JOIN StudentSubjects AS ss ON s.FULL_NAME = ss.FULL_NAME ORDER BY sc.subject_count DESC, s.LAST_NAME, ss.SUBJECT_ID LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON at.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE WHERE cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, MIN(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > MIN(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_AVG' WHEN AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) < MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_AVG' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS avg_units_category FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.TERM_CODE = cso.TERM_CODE AND cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS Most_Prominent_Library_Offer_Dept, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Enrolled_Student_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = lso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS dept_rank FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) AS ranked_lso ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = ranked_lso.SUBJECT_ID AND lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ranked_lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = ranked_lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS WHERE ranked_lso.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Graduate_Student_Count FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY Graduate_Student_Count DESC LIMIT 10), SchoolGeomMeanUnits AS (SELECT sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, EXP(AVG(LN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.Graduate_Student_Count, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, sgm.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sgm.geometric_mean_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SchoolGeomMeanUnits AS sgm ON ic.SCHOOL_NAME = sgm.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY ic.Graduate_Student_Count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptTotalEnrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students, MAX(scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING) AS IS_DEGREE_GRANTING FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE AS MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM DeptTotalEnrolled AS dte JOIN DeptMaxEnrolled2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.total_enrolled_students, inner_cte.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLED_COURSE_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.total_enrolled_students DESC, inner_cte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS grad_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, inner_cte.grad_student_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, SUBJECT_TITLE, LECTURE_UNITS, LAB_UNITS, TOTAL_UNITS, GRADE_TYPE, GRADE_RULE, min_total_units_by_dept FROM inner_cte WHERE TOTAL_UNITS > (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND t2.GRADE_TYPE = 'L') SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, window_column FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, window_column ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH course_desc_stats AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top_math_courses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM top_math_courses AS tmc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats AS cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, tmc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tmc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tmc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code, scd.FROM_TERM, scd.FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, scd.SCHOOL_NAME, sad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER ORDER BY tmc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.FROM_TERM) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(COURSE_NUMBER) OVER (ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM) = COURSE_NUMBER THEN NULL ELSE COURSE_NUMBER END AS COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_DESCRIPTION, SUBJECT_TITLE, offer_count, DEPARTMENT_NAME, course_description_count, min_cip_program_code, FROM_TERM, FROM_TERM_DESCRIPTION, SCHOOL_NAME, DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte ORDER BY COURSE_NUMBER, FROM_TERM
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 3 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 AND NOT t0.TERM_CODE IS NULL AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N'), SubjectReserveStats AS (SELECT t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserved_materials, MIN(a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, MIN(a.TERM_DESCRIPTION) AS min_term_description FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON l.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10 AND t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_CODE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.max_enrolled_students, r.num_reserved_materials, r.min_academic_year, r.min_term_description FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN SubjectReserveStats AS r ON s.SUBJECT_TITLE = r.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = r.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, CAST(STDDEV_SAMP(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS REAL) / NULLIF(AVG(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS), 0) AS coefficient_of_variation, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING COUNT(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0) SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, 'Department 2022' AS Source FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Political Science' UNION ALL SELECT ccso.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.TOTAL_UNITS, 'Admin Department 2024' AS Source FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE UPPER(sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) = 'MECHANICAL ENGINEERING' AND ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 ORDER BY 1, 2, 3
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE), MathGradStudentCount AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.LECTURE_UNITS, icte.LAB_UNITS, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.GRADE_TYPE, icte.GRADE_RULE, icte.min_total_units_by_dept, mgsc.total_graduate_students, sd.SCHOOL_NAME AS school_name, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS department_phone FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN MathGradStudentCount AS mgsc ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 100) SELECT sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE sos.TERM_CODE IN ('2021FA', '2022FA') AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' ORDER BY sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = tso.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_SUMMER_TERM = 'N' GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_TITLE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_num_window, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.IS_PRINTED_IN_BULLETIN = 'Y' AND c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_TITLE), MathDeptEnrolled AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON lso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ccs.SUBJECT_ID WHERE ata.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.row_num_window, mde.total_enrolled, sd.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN MathDeptEnrolled AS mde ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mde.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.TERM_CODE ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS, COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 1) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0), COALESCE(LEAD(c.TOTAL_UNITS, 2) OVER (PARTITION BY c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER ORDER BY c.SUBJECT_CODE), 0)) AS max_total_units_3rows FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), TermMaxUnits AS (SELECT TERM_CODE, MAX(max_total_units_3rows) AS term_max_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.window_column, i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.max_total_units_3rows FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TermMaxUnits AS tmu ON i.TERM_CODE = tmu.TERM_CODE WHERE i.max_total_units_3rows > 0.75 * tmu.term_max_units ORDER BY i.TERM_CODE, i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE) AS num_unique_courses, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME), math_admin_dept_count AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS admin_dept_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY admin_dept_count DESC LIMIT 10), math_grad_student_count AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS num_grad_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND NOT d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_unique_courses, ic.num_students, madc.admin_dept_count, mgsc.num_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN math_admin_dept_count AS madc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = madc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN math_grad_student_count AS mgsc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgsc.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH course_desc_stats AS (SELECT scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION) AS course_description_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_program_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY scd.COURSE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), top_chem_courses AS (SELECT ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(*) AS offer_count FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON ssc.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY ssc.COURSE_NUMBER, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ccc.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY offer_count DESC LIMIT 3) SELECT tcc.COURSE_NUMBER, tcc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tcc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code FROM top_chem_courses AS tcc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON tcc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION = scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION JOIN course_desc_stats AS cds ON scd.COURSE = cds.COURSE AND cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Chemistry' GROUP BY tcc.COURSE_NUMBER, tcc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, tcc.SUBJECT_TITLE, tcc.offer_count, cds.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cds.course_description_count, cds.min_cip_program_code ORDER BY tcc.offer_count DESC) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, AVG(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units_in_building FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON icte.SUBJECT_CODE = sc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND sc.SUBJECT_CODE = cso.SUBJECT_CODE AND cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' AND cso.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS fr ON cso.MEET_PLACE = fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID) = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME THEN NULL ELSE s.DEPARTMENT_NAME END AS department_name, s.FIRST_NAME, s.LAST_NAME, s.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, p.SUBJECT_ID, p.SUBJECT_TITLE, p.running_sum_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS s JOIN (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') AS p ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = p.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON p.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY department_name, s.LAST_NAME, p.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS math_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.math_avg_total_units, (inner_cte.math_avg_total_units - all_avg.all_subjects_avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_all_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS all_subjects_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS all_avg ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = all_avg.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH dept_total_enrolled AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON scd.COURSE = ssc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND (scd.SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') OR scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING total_enrolled_students > 20), dept_max_enrolled_2019 AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND ((sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') OR (lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry')) AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso2 WHERE lso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND lso2.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5) ORDER BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dte.total_enrolled_students, dme.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, dme.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM dept_total_enrolled AS dte LEFT JOIN dept_max_enrolled_2019 AS dme ON dte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dme.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.total_enrolled_students, icte.MAX_NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, COALESCE(cnt.num_distinct_courses, 0) AS num_distinct_courses_2019_gt5 FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT lso.COURSE_NUMBER) AS num_distinct_courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE LIKE '2019%' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS cnt ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cnt.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, icte.GRADUATE_LEVEL, icte.Total_Courses, des.avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS des ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = des.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ms.SUBJECT_ID, ms.SUBJECT_CODE, ms.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ms.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ms.SUBJECT_TITLE, ms.LECTURE_UNITS, ms.LAB_UNITS, ms.TOTAL_UNITS, ms.GRADE_TYPE, ms.GRADE_RULE, ms.min_total_units_by_dept, mgs.total_graduate_students, ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.LECTURE_UNITS, t0.LAB_UNITS, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.GRADE_TYPE, t0.GRADE_RULE, MIN(t0.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS min_total_units_by_dept, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS ms JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS mgs ON ms.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ms.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mgs.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_NUMBER, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.LECTURE_UNITS, ic.LAB_UNITS, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.GRADE_TYPE, ic.GRADE_RULE, ic.min_total_units_by_dept, ic.total_graduate_students, scd.COURSE_DESCRIPTION_LONG AS department_description FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND scd.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' ORDER BY ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TotalUnits AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0), CourseStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.SCHOOL_NAME, cs.course_count, cs.min_cip_code, tu.total_units, ROUND(CAST(tu.total_units AS REAL) / NULLIF(cs.course_count, 0), 2) AS avg_units_per_course FROM CourseStats AS cs JOIN TotalUnits AS tu ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = tu.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, icte.total_units, icte.avg_units_per_course, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, icte.total_units, icte.avg_units_per_course, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t2.SUBJECT_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6 AND t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'), math_grad_students AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), all_grad_students AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(msd.FULL_NAME) AS total_graduate_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_grad_students AS (SELECT AVG(total_graduate_students) AS avg_grad_students FROM all_grad_students) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_NUMBER, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.window_column, mgs.total_graduate_students, CASE WHEN mgs.total_graduate_students > ags.avg_grad_students THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN mgs.total_graduate_students < ags.avg_grad_students THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS grad_student_status FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN math_grad_students AS mgs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = mgs.DEPARTMENT_NAME CROSS JOIN avg_grad_students AS ags ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH most_recent_year AS (SELECT MAX(ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS max_year FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ccs.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ccs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '7' AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = (SELECT max_year FROM most_recent_year) AND NOT ccs.TOTAL_UNITS IS NULL GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT dau.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE, dau.avg_total_units FROM dept_avg_units AS dau ORDER BY dau.avg_total_units DESC LIMIT 10), most_common_student_year AS (SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY msd.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.avg_total_units, mcs.STUDENT_YEAR AS most_common_student_year, mcs.student_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN most_common_student_year AS mcs ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mcs.DEPARTMENT AND mcs.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.COURSE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t2.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), student_summary AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'), department_info AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS num_students FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d LEFT JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column AS subject_window_rank, st.FIRST_NAME, st.LAST_NAME, st.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS student_department_name, st.STUDENT_YEAR, st.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, st.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, st.window_column AS student_window_avg_phone, di.SCHOOL_NAME AS department_school_name, di.num_students AS department_num_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN student_summary AS st ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = st.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN department_info AS di ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = di.DEPARTMENT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS academic_year, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ata.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON tso.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology') GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TopMathFallSubjects AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE ccs.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT i.department, i.academic_year, i.subject_count AS chem_bio_subject_count, i.min_term_start_date, i.avg_enrolled_students, t.subject_count AS math_fall_subject_count FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN TopMathFallSubjects AS t ON i.academic_year = t.academic_year ORDER BY i.department, i.academic_year
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0 OR (sos.TOTAL_UNITS BETWEEN 1 AND 21)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, icte.min_num_enrolled_students, icte.avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT sc.COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN inner_cte AS icte ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (ORDER BY t1.LAST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') SELECT ps.FIRST_NAME, ps.LAST_NAME, ps.EMAIL_ADDRESS, ps.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ps.SCHOOL_NAME, ps.MAX_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, pss.SUBJECT_ID, pss.SUBJECT_TITLE, pss.running_sum_total_units, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS ps JOIN (SELECT sos.SUBJECT_ID, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY sos.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_sum_total_units, scd.DEPARTMENT, sos.COURSE_NUMBER FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sos.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science') AS pss ON ps.DEPARTMENT_CODE = pss.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON pss.COURSE_NUMBER = sc.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY ps.LAST_NAME, pss.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(t0.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.SCHOOL_CODE = t1.SCHOOL_CODE WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' ORDER BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Subquery2 AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON sc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT sq1.SUBJECT_CODE, sq1.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq1.SCHOOL_NAME, sq1.avg_dept_budget_code, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.TOTAL_UNITS, sq2.window_column, sq2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM Subquery1 AS sq1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON sq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND sq1.SCHOOL_NAME = d.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN Subquery2 AS sq2 ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sq2.DEPARTMENT_CODE), school_enrollment_avg AS (SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.avg_dept_budget_code, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.window_column, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > s.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < s.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN school_enrollment_avg AS s ON i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT msd.FIRST_NAME, msd.LAST_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) OVER (PARTITION BY sd.SCHOOL_NAME) AS MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, msd.FULL_NAME FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE msd.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID) = inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME END AS SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FIRST_NAME, inner_cte.LAST_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.MIN_DEPT_BUDGET_CODE, sp.MIT_ID, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON AS sp ON inner_cte.FULL_NAME = sp.FULL_NAME AND sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd2.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd2.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units, eng_window.SUBJECT_TITLE, eng_window.DEPARTMENT_NAME, eng_window.SCHOOL_NAME, eng_window.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS ENG_ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, eng_window.window_column, COALESCE(td.tip_count, 0) AS tip_detail_record_count FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.TERM_CODE, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ata.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON s.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 1 AND s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') AS eng_window ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = eng_window.ACADEMIC_YEAR LEFT JOIN (SELECT SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS tip_count FROM TIP_DETAIL GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID, TERM_CODE) AS td ON eng_window.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID AND eng_window.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, eng_window.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH largest_room_per_floor AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 100 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE = (SELECT MAX(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 WHERE sd2.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY AND sd2.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24') ORDER BY sf.FLOOR_NAME), room_and_avg_per_floor AS (SELECT sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, AVG(sd2.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sd.FLOOR_KEY FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY JOIN SPACE_DETAIL AS sd2 ON sd2.FLOOR_KEY = sd.FLOOR_KEY WHERE sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32 AND sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > 10 GROUP BY sd.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.FLOOR_KEY ORDER BY sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT lrf.FLOOR_NAME, lrf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME AS LARGEST_ROOM_NAME, lrf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE AS LARGEST_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.BUILDING_ROOM_NAME, raf.ROOM_NUMBER, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE, raf.AVG_ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE_PER_FLOOR, sf.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE AS FLOOR_WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM largest_room_per_floor AS lrf JOIN room_and_avg_per_floor AS raf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = raf.FLOOR_NAME JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON lrf.FLOOR_NAME = sf.FLOOR_NAME ORDER BY lrf.FLOOR_NAME, raf.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) SELECT * FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, SUM(CASE WHEN o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS assignable_organization_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.DLC_NAME LIKE '%Office%' AND LOWER(o.DLC_NAME) <> LOWER('Biology') GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME), Dept_Max_Org_Space AS (SELECT mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_KEY, mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT), Org_Earliest_Load AS (SELECT o.DLC_KEY, MIN(o.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.DLC_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.assignable_organization_count, dmos.department, dmos.max_organization_number, dmos.space_unit_name, oel.earliest_warehouse_load_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN Dept_Max_Org_Space AS dmos ON ic.DLC_KEY = dmos.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN Org_Earliest_Load AS oel ON ic.DLC_KEY = oel.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), dept_avg AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(subject_count) AS avg_subject_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, d.avg_subject_count, CASE WHEN i.subject_count > d.avg_subject_count * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.subject_count < d.avg_subject_count * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.COURSE) AS total_courses, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.CATEGORY_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_records FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2020 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION), avg_cte AS (SELECT AVG(total_tip_records) AS avg_tip_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.TERM_CODE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_count, i.total_tip_records, CASE WHEN i.total_tip_records > a.avg_tip_records * 1.2 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.total_tip_records < a.avg_tip_records * 0.8 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS tip_record_status FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_cte AS a

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(h.FCLT_BUILDING_HIST_KEY) AS hist_count FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS f JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS h ON f.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = h.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY GROUP BY f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY hist_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME) = inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME END AS building_name, inner_cte.hist_count, f.BUILDING_TYPE, f.CAMPUS_SECTOR FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS f ON inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME = f.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.hist_count DESC, inner_cte.BUILDING_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units, (inner_cte.dept_avg_total_units - overall.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_overall_avg FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(dept_avg_total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_avgs GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS overall ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = overall.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, deviation_from_overall_avg DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, so.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') AS so ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = so.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = so.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND so.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT td.SUBJECT_ID, MIN(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS min_record_count, SUM(ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS total_academic_years FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND atp.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY td.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.min_record_count, inner_cte.total_academic_years, CASE WHEN inner_cte.min_record_count > (SELECT AVG(min_record_count) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.min_record_count < (SELECT AVG(min_record_count) FROM inner_cte) THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS record_count_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.FISCAL_YEAR, t0.FY_QUARTER_CODE, t0.QUARTER_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_YEAR, t1.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, t1.CALENDAR_MONTH, AVG(t1.CALENDAR_MONTH) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FISCAL_PERIOD ORDER BY t0.FISCAL_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg FROM TIME_QUARTER AS t0 JOIN TIME_MONTH AS t1 ON t0.FISCAL_YEAR = t1.FISCAL_YEAR WHERE t0.FISCAL_YEAR = 2026) SELECT inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR, inner_cte.FY_QUARTER_CODE, inner_cte.QUARTER_START_DATE, inner_cte.CALENDAR_YEAR, inner_cte.CALENDAR_PERIOD_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH_NAME, inner_cte.window_avg, CASE WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH > inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.CALENDAR_MONTH < inner_cte.window_avg THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AT_AVERAGE' END AS month_vs_window FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.FISCAL_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students, year_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS Peak_Year_Desc, year_stats.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Enrolled_Students DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Year_Enrolled_Students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS year_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = year_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND year_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO' AND at.ACADEMIC_YEAR > 2015 AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 5 GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME), avg_counts AS (SELECT AVG(eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units, CASE WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units > a.avg_count * 1.5 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units < a.avg_count * 0.5 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_counts AS a ON 1 = 1 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.eo_materials_after_2015_with_high_units, a.avg_count

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sos.TERM_CODE = '2016SP') SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - avg_dept.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_dept ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_dept.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) SELECT s.SCHOOL_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geom_mean FROM inner_cte) AS a ON i.geometric_mean_area > a.avg_geom_mean ORDER BY i.geometric_mean_area DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NAME AS HIST_BUILDING_NAME, t0.BUILDING_TYPE, t1.BUILDING_TYPE AS HIST_BUILDING_TYPE, t0.BUILDING_HEIGHT FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_CENTER_CODE = t1.COST_CENTER_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_OF_ROOMS > 50) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(BUILDING_NAME) OVER (ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT) = BUILDING_NAME THEN NULL ELSE BUILDING_NAME END AS BUILDING_NAME, HIST_BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_TYPE, HIST_BUILDING_TYPE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY BUILDING_HEIGHT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND t2.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), avg_units_cte AS (SELECT AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < a.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_units_cte AS a
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = 'HE'), DepartmentTotals AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, NULL AS total_subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, dt.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, dt.total_subjects FROM DepartmentTotals AS dt ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE su.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '19-DEC-24' AND hou.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE = '03-DEC-24'), avg_codes AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT, AVG(CAST(HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS REAL)) AS avg_hr_dept_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, (CAST(i.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE AS REAL) - a.avg_hr_dept_code) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_codes AS a ON i.SPACE_UNIT = a.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS math_iap_activities_2021 FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON isd.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2021 AND isd.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2009 AND inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE min_warehouse_load_date > '01-JAN-20' ORDER BY CATEGORY_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserve_count FROM LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS AS lms JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY WHERE lrmd.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY lms.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS) SELECT inner_cte.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS, inner_cte.reserve_count, avg_stats.avg_count, CASE WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count > avg_stats.avg_count * 1.1 THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN inner_cte.reserve_count < avg_stats.avg_count * 0.9 THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS status_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(reserve_count) AS avg_count FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.reserve_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR = at2.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND at2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA' WHERE at2.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y'

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - min_enrolled_students_per_dept) AS deviation_from_min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), org_avg_area AS (SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN org_avg_area AS a ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND r.AREA > a.avg_area
