WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, (inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - inner_cte.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, zr.FLOOR, AVG(zr.ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS zr ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = zr.SPACE_UNIT_CODE GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT, zr.FLOOR) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(avg_access_level) AS highest_avg_access_level_per_floor FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, o.OWNER_TYPE, d.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, o.OWNER, d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE FROM MOIRA_LIST_DETAIL AS d JOIN MOIRA_LIST_OWNER AS o ON d.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY = o.MOIRA_LIST_OWNER_KEY WHERE d.LAST_UPDATE_DATE = '18-DEC-24'), avg_mit_id AS (SELECT OWNER_TYPE, AVG(MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID) AS avg_mit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OWNER_TYPE) SELECT i.MOIRA_LIST_KEY, i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_FULL_NAME, i.OWNER_TYPE, i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID, i.OWNER, i.LAST_UPDATE_DATE, CASE WHEN i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID > a.avg_mit_id THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN i.MOIRA_LIST_MEMBER_MIT_ID < a.avg_mit_id THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS mit_id_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_mit_id AS a ON i.OWNER_TYPE = a.OWNER_TYPE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.DLC_KEY, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.organization_count, ic.min_organization_number, mo.MAJOR_ORG AS Most_Prominent_Major_Org, mo.Major_Org_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS Major_Org_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) DESC) AS rn FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG) AS mo ON ic.DLC_KEY = mo.DLC_KEY AND ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = mo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND mo.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.organization_count DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE HAVING SUM(d.RECORD_COUNT) > 0), benchmark_cte AS (SELECT m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.YEAR > 2010 AND m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 10 GROUP BY m.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE), overall_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_records) AS avg_total_records FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE, i.total_records, b.avg_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.total_records > ob.avg_total_records * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_RECORDS' WHEN i.total_records < ob.avg_total_records * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_RECORDS' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS records_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN benchmark_cte AS b ON i.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE = b.MATERIAL_INFO_SOURCE CROSS JOIN overall_benchmark AS ob

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY WHERE SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND TOTAL_UNITS = 1 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ACTIVITY_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBJECT_DEPT FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y'), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT SUBJECT_DEPT, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_DEPT) SELECT i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.GRADE_TYPE_DESC FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg_units AS d ON i.SUBJECT_DEPT = d.SUBJECT_DEPT WHERE i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS avg_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND c.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT SCHOOL_NAME, MAX(avg_cip_code) AS highest_avg_cip_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME) = DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS major_use_description, BUILDING_ROOM, AREA, ORGANIZATION_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), dept_counts AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_CODE), term_avgs AS (SELECT TERM_CODE, AVG(dept_subject_count) AS avg_subjects_per_dept FROM dept_counts GROUP BY TERM_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, i.window_column, CASE WHEN d.dept_subject_count > t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN d.dept_subject_count < t.avg_subjects_per_dept THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS dept_subjects_status FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_counts AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE JOIN term_avgs AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, AVG(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, MIN(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(ic.student_count) AS total_unique_students, MIN(ic.min_cip_code) AS min_cip_code, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(student_count) AS total_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_students DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_depts JOIN inner_cte AS ic ON top_depts.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic2.COURSE_LEVEL AS Most_Common_Course_Level, ic2.student_count AS Level_Student_Count FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, student_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY student_count DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte) AS ic2 WHERE ic2.rn = 1) AS cc ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = cc.DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cc.Most_Common_Course_Level, cc.Level_Student_Count ORDER BY total_unique_students DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_NUMBER, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > (SELECT AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2024)

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(TOTAL_UNITS) AS highest_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY highest_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012) SELECT i.SUBJECT_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, d.dept_subject_count, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(i.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = a.SCHOOL_NAME WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled GROUP BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sf.FLOOR_NAME, sd.ROOM_NUMBER, sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_FLOOR AS sf ON sd.FLOOR_KEY = sf.FLOOR_KEY), avg_sqft AS (SELECT FLOOR_NAME, AVG(ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS avg_sqft FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FLOOR_NAME) SELECT i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER, i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_sqft AS a ON i.FLOOR_NAME = a.FLOOR_NAME WHERE i.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE > a.avg_sqft ORDER BY i.FLOOR_NAME, i.ROOM_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.window_column, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID AND t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_ID, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.ISBN, c.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON c.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE a.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'), avg_units AS (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ISBN, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - a.avg_total_units) AS units_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_units AS a ON i.TERM_DESCRIPTION = a.TERM_DESCRIPTION
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_CODE) AS Total_Subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_counts.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id, MAX(h.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS latest_hr_org_unit_load_date FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME GROUP BY i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.hr_org_unit_count, i.total_department_id
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, MAX(subject_count) AS highest_subject_count, MIN(min_term_start_date) AS earliest_term_start_date FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year >= 2010 THEN 'RECENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year < 1980 THEN 'OLD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS year_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_degree_year DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sos.COURSE_NUMBER, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > da.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < da.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_load_category FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS da ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = da.OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS num_space_units FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.MAJOR_ORG IN ('PROVST', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) > 2) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.num_space_units, fo.DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT BUILDING_ROOM, FLOOR, ROOM, SPACE_ID, AREA, MAJOR_USE, DESCRIPTION, min_area_per_major_use, CASE WHEN AREA > min_area_per_major_use * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_ROOM' WHEN AREA < min_area_per_major_use * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_ROOM' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS room_size_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.window_column, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.num_reserve_materials FROM (SELECT inner_cte.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.num_reserve_materials DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte WHERE inner_cte.TERM_CODE = (SELECT MAX(TERM_CODE) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED)) AS ic WHERE ic.rn <= 5 ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.num_reserve_materials DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(td.ISBN) AS min_isbn FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_materials FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.subject_count, i.min_isbn
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE = t1.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date, MAX(t.END_DATE) AS latest_end_date FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE GROUP BY ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(subject_code_count) AS highest_subject_code_count, MIN(min_dept_budget_code) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives') SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, MAX(running_enrollment_sum) AS max_running_enrollment_sum FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.MAJOR_ORG) SELECT MAJOR_ORG, ORGANIZATION_NAME, geometric_mean FROM inner_cte UNION ALL SELECT MAJOR_ORG, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(geometric_mean))) AS geometric_mean FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_ORG ORDER BY MAJOR_ORG, ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS min_material_status, SUM(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_records, MIN(lrmd.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) AS earliest_load_date FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lrmd.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrmd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT min_material_status, total_records, earliest_load_date FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fok JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fok.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.space_unit_count, avg_stats.avg_space_units, CASE WHEN ic.space_unit_count > avg_stats.avg_space_units * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_HOLDER' WHEN ic.space_unit_count < avg_stats.avg_space_units * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_HOLDER' ELSE 'AVERAGE_HOLDER' END AS holder_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(space_unit_count) AS avg_space_units FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM FCLT_ROOMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.MEET_PLACE WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY FCLT_ROOMS.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, MAX(avg_total_units) AS highest_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY highest_avg_total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE AS course_number, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.COURSE) AS window_column, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT i.course_number, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS m ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = m.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = m.max_enrolled
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON lso.TERM_CODE = tso.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd ON tso.TERM_CODE = lrd.TERM_CODE WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2009JA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2009JA')
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, AVG(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON tso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND tso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2005FA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, DEPARTMENT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t.ISBN) AS isbn_count, MIN(ts.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS min_faculty_mit_id FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ts ON t.SUBJECT_ID = ts.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, ic.isbn_count, ic.min_faculty_mit_id, stc.Most_Common_Subject_Title, stc.Subject_Title_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Most_Common_Subject_Title, COUNT(*) AS Subject_Title_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS stc ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = stc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = stc.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC AND stc.rn = 1 ORDER BY (SELECT SUM(l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l2 WHERE l2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND l2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC = ic.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC AND l2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3) DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT BETWEEN 15 AND 30 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = 'Advance sign-up required') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, COUNT(m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, MIN(m.USED_SHELF_PRICE) AS min_used_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) SELECT i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.PUBLISHER, i.material_count, i.min_used_price, s.avg_new_shelf_price AS benchmark_new_shelf_price, CASE WHEN i.min_used_price < s.avg_new_shelf_price * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_USED_PRICE' WHEN i.min_used_price > s.avg_new_shelf_price * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_USED_PRICE' ELSE 'AVERAGE_USED_PRICE' END AS used_price_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER, AVG(m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE) AS avg_new_shelf_price FROM TIP_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIP_MATERIAL AS m ON d.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = m.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY WHERE m.NEW_SHELF_PRICE > 50 GROUP BY d.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, m.PUBLISHER) AS s ON i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = s.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY AND i.PUBLISHER = s.PUBLISHER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT t3.DLC_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.window_column) AS highest_dense_rank FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t3 ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = t3.DLC_KEY GROUP BY t3.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), RoomCounts AS (SELECT DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DESCRIPTION) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.AREA, ic.DESCRIPTION, ic.window_column FROM inner_cte AS ic UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, rc.DESCRIPTION, rc.total_rooms AS window_column FROM RoomCounts AS rc ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA') SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, (NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - window_column) AS deviation_from_min FROM inner_cte ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.TERM_START_DATE, i.window_column, y.total_materials_per_year FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(*) AS total_materials_per_year FROM (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS y ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = y.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) AS sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, num_reserve_materials FROM inner_cte WHERE num_reserve_materials > (SELECT AVG(num_reserve_materials) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS total_degree_years FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y') SELECT at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MIN(at.DEGREE_YEAR) AS min_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON at.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, MAX(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS = 1), avg_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 INNER JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT cte.SUBJECT_ID, cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS > a.avg_total_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE' WHEN cte.TOTAL_UNITS < a.avg_total_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE' ELSE 'EQUAL_TO_AVERAGE' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN avg_units AS a ON cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_USAGE, inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT, RoomCounts.Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT) AS RoomCounts ON inner_cte.SPACE_UNIT = RoomCounts.SPACE_UNIT
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_budget_code, SUM(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum, sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, COUNT(DISTINCT ccc.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS unique_courses FROM inner_cte JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, iap.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS iap JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON iap.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON ata.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE WHERE iap.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION NOT LIKE '%Summer%' GROUP BY iap.ACTIVITY_TITLE, iap.TERM_CODE ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), DeptCounts AS (SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS dept_count, icte.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE), TopDept AS (SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS subj_in_dept, icte.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON icte.TERM_CODE = ccs.TERM_CODE GROUP BY icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TERM_CODE) SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.dept_count, t.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS top_department FROM DeptCounts AS d LEFT JOIN TopDept AS t ON d.ACTIVITY_TITLE = t.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.rn = 1 ORDER BY d.dept_count DESC, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(DISTINCT t.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_tip_subjects, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_library_enrollment, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON t.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.TERM_CODE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(num_tip_subjects) AS total_tip_subjects, MAX(total_library_enrollment) AS max_total_library_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT SPACE_UNIT, room_count FROM inner_cte WHERE UPPER(SPACE_UNIT) LIKE 'A%' AND room_count BETWEEN 5 AND 15
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < d.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, c.PROGRAM_CODE, c.PROGRAM_TITLE, c.CATEGORY_CODE, c.CATEGORY_TITLE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, c.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, MIN(c.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY c.CATEGORY_CODE ORDER BY c.CATEGORY_CODE) AS min_warehouse_load_date FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS s JOIN CIP AS c ON c.PROGRAM_CODE = s.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE WHERE s.DEPARTMENT = 6), SchoolTotals AS (SELECT NULL AS COURSE, NULL AS COURSE_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS PROGRAM_CODE, NULL AS PROGRAM_TITLE, NULL AS CATEGORY_CODE, NULL AS CATEGORY_TITLE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, NULL AS FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, NULL AS min_warehouse_load_date, COUNT(*) AS total_courses FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT i.COURSE, i.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.PROGRAM_CODE, i.PROGRAM_TITLE, i.CATEGORY_CODE, i.CATEGORY_TITLE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, i.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, i.min_warehouse_load_date, NULL AS total_courses FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT s.COURSE, s.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, s.PROGRAM_CODE, s.PROGRAM_TITLE, s.CATEGORY_CODE, s.CATEGORY_TITLE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_CODE, s.FOUR_DIGIT_TITLE, s.min_warehouse_load_date, s.total_courses FROM SchoolTotals AS s ORDER BY SCHOOL_NAME, CATEGORY_CODE, COURSE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.SUBJECT_CODE, c.SUBJECT_NUMBER, c.SUBJECT_TITLE, c.TOTAL_UNITS, c.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective'), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, COUNT(*) OVER (PARTITION BY i.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS num_hass_electives_in_department, CASE WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units THEN 'ABOVE_AVERAGE_UNITS' WHEN i.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units THEN 'BELOW_AVERAGE_UNITS' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNITS' END AS unit_comparison FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg_units AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.AREA, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), DeptAvg AS (SELECT DEPT_CODE, AVG(AREA) AS dept_avg_area FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPT_CODE HAVING AVG(AREA) > 400) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.MAJOR_USE_DESC, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.DLC_KEY, ic.window_avg_area FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN DeptAvg AS da ON ic.DEPT_CODE = da.DEPT_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_NAME, t1.BUILDING_NUMBER, t0.CITY, t0.STATE, AVG(t1.NUM_OF_ROOMS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_NUMBER) AS avg_num_of_rooms FROM FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = t1.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE t0.CITY = 'CAMBRIDGE') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE, MAX(avg_num_of_rooms) AS max_avg_num_of_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY BUILDING_NAME, BUILDING_NUMBER, CITY, STATE ORDER BY BUILDING_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME), dept_avg AS (SELECT AVG(offered_subject_count) AS avg_offered_subjects FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.offered_subject_count, i.min_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN i.offered_subject_count > d.avg_offered_subjects * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ACTIVITY' WHEN i.offered_subject_count < d.avg_offered_subjects * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ACTIVITY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS activity_level FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN dept_avg AS d
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, window_column, DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, COUNT(DISTINCT LRM.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS unique_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS AT ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = AT.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND AT.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS LRM ON LRM.TERM_CODE = AT.TERM_CODE AND LRM.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_term_start_date, tip_counts.total_tip_materials FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS tip_counts ON inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = tip_counts.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tip_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS unique_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), isbn_counts AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS materials_with_isbn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND NOT TIP_DETAIL.ISBN IS NULL GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.unique_materials, isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn FROM inner_cte JOIN isbn_counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = isbn_counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC WHERE isbn_counts.materials_with_isbn >= 0.5 * inner_cte.unique_materials ORDER BY inner_cte.unique_materials DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment, CASE WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_counts.num_subjects, ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_KEY) AS num_subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.COURSE_NUMBER, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dept_enroll.total_enrollment, top_course.COURSE_NUMBER AS highest_enrolled_course, top_course.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS course_enrollment FROM (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_enroll JOIN (SELECT i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i1.COURSE_NUMBER, i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM inner_cte AS i1 JOIN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enroll FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS i2 ON i1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = i2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = i2.max_enroll) AS top_course ON dept_enroll.DEPARTMENT_NAME = top_course.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dept_enroll.total_enrollment DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key, MAX(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS max_org_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.DLC_CODE) AS unique_lvl3_dlc_codes FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m2 ON m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE = m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE AND m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY avg_org_key DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS total_organizations, f.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON d.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ORG_PARENT IN ('EXECVP', 'CHNCLR') GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, f.DLC_KEY) SELECT icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(icte.total_organizations) AS total_organizations, icte.DLC_KEY AS Most_Represented_DLC, dlc.DLC_NAME, icte.DLC_Org_Count FROM (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS DLC_Org_Count, SUM(total_organizations) AS total_organizations FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY) AS icte JOIN (SELECT DISTINCT DLC_KEY, DLC_NAME FROM HR_ORG_UNIT) AS dlc ON icte.DLC_KEY = dlc.DLC_KEY JOIN (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(DLC_Org_Count) AS max_count FROM (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY, COUNT(*) AS DLC_Org_Count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, DLC_KEY) AS sub GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS max_dlc ON icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = max_dlc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.DLC_Org_Count = max_dlc.max_count GROUP BY icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, dlc.DLC_NAME, icte.DLC_Org_Count ORDER BY total_organizations DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) SELECT i.SPACE_UNIT, i.room_count FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT AVG(room_count) AS avg_room_count FROM (SELECT COUNT(sd.BUILDING_ROOM) AS room_count FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON sd.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY GROUP BY su.SPACE_UNIT) AS sub) AS a ON 1 = 1 WHERE i.room_count > a.avg_room_count

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_NAME, t1.FISCAL_PERIOD, t1.ASSIGNABLE_AREA FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS t0 JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS t1 ON t0.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY = t1.COST_COLLECTOR_KEY WHERE t0.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND t0.CAMPUS_SECTOR = 'MAIN GROUP') SELECT BUILDING_NAME, FISCAL_PERIOD, MAX(ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY BUILDING_NAME) AS max_assignable_area, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY ASSIGNABLE_AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE, t1.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS t1 ON t0.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = t1.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022) SELECT HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM, MAX(window_column) AS max_row_number FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HASS_ATTRIBUTE, DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, s.benchmark_enrollment, CASE WHEN i.min_total_units > s.benchmark_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.min_total_units < s.benchmark_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS benchmark_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = s.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.geometric_mean, avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean, CASE WHEN ic.geometric_mean > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH' WHEN ic.geometric_mean < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.8 THEN 'LOW' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t2.ORG_PARENT, t2.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY WHERE t2.FCLT_MAJOR_ORG_KEY = 230) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, ic.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, AVG(ic.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY ic.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, dept_stats.Top_Department, dept_stats.Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Top_Department, COUNT(*) AS Department_Org_Count FROM inner_cte AS ic2 GROUP BY ic2.ORG_PARENT, ic2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MAX(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM inner_cte AS ic3 WHERE ic3.ORG_PARENT = ic2.ORG_PARENT GROUP BY ic3.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub)) AS dept_stats ON ic.ORG_PARENT = dept_stats.ORG_PARENT AND ic.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = dept_stats.Top_Department WHERE ic.ORG_PARENT IN (SELECT org_parent FROM (SELECT ic4.ORG_PARENT AS org_parent, COUNT(*) AS total_orgs FROM inner_cte AS ic4 GROUP BY ic4.ORG_PARENT ORDER BY total_orgs DESC LIMIT 10) AS top_parents) ORDER BY ic.ORG_PARENT, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS total_tip_materials FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.total_tip_materials, (inner_cte.total_tip_materials - (SELECT AVG(total_tip_materials) FROM inner_cte)) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY deviation_from_avg DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.SUBJECT_KEY, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, AVG(t0.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER, inner_cte.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY, inner_cte.window_column AS avg_enrollment_number, (inner_cte.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER - inner_cte.window_column) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS min_lecture_units, SUM(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION LIKE 'Fall Term%' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, AVG(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) AS department_geometric_mean, AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) AS department_avg_total_units, CASE WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) > AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN AVG(inner_cte.geometric_mean_total_units) < AVG(inner_cte.avg_total_units) * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, s.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON c.HGN_CODE = s.HGN_CODE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND c.LECTURE_UNITS > 2 GROUP BY c.HGN_CODE, c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING MAX(c.LECTURE_UNITS) > 2), avg_lecture AS (SELECT HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(LECTURE_UNITS) AS avg_lecture_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 GROUP BY HGN_CODE, DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.HGN_CODE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_lecture_units, i.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_lecture AS a ON i.HGN_CODE = a.HGN_CODE AND i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.max_lecture_units > a.avg_lecture_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, at.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY ss.SUBJECT_GROUP_ID ORDER BY lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_total_units, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2019SP') SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(SUBJECT_TITLE) OVER (ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME) = SUBJECT_TITLE THEN NULL ELSE SUBJECT_TITLE END AS subject_title, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, TOTAL_UNITS, avg_total_units, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND NOT s.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC IS NULL) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY highest_enrolled_students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, AVG(t1.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, MAX(window_column) AS max_windowed_avg_record_count FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, SUM(fo.ORGANIZATION_ID) AS sum_org_id, fo.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fo.ORG_PARENT = 'EXECVP' GROUP BY fo.DLC_KEY) SELECT DLC_KEY, min_org_number, sum_org_id FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, MIN(t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.LIBRARY_COURSE_INSTRUCTOR_KEY, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.window_column, sub_counts.total_reserve_materials FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.TERM_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 WHERE t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY t2.SUBJECT_ID, t2.TERM_CODE) AS sub_counts ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = sub_counts.SUBJECT_ID AND icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION = (SELECT TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS WHERE TERM_CODE = sub_counts.TERM_CODE)
WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012), Subquery2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SCHOOL_CODE) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT t0.SCHOOL_CODE IS NULL AND NOT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_row_number, s2.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.window_column AS school_dense_rank FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON so.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s2.SUBJECT_CODE
WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.MAJOR_USE
WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2010FA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.window_column, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS TERM_END_DATE, NULL AS TERM_PARAMETER, NULL AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, '2010FA' AS SOURCE_TERM FROM Subq1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, NULL AS window_column, s2.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.TERM_END_DATE, s2.TERM_PARAMETER, s2.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, '2025FA' AS SOURCE_TERM FROM Subq2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects ORDER BY SUBJECT_ID, SOURCE_TERM
