ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY department_geometric_mean DESC), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.subject_count, s1.min_total_units, s2.department_geometric_mean, s2.department_avg_total_units, s2.unit_category FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, DEPARTMENT_NAME, subject_count, min_total_units, department_geometric_mean, department_avg_total_units, unit_category FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats ORDER BY inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC), DepartmentYearStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM WITH org_avg_area AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, VARIANCE(r.AREA) AS area_variance FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY area_variance DESC), org_avg_area AS (SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, AVG(r.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN org_avg_area AS a ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = a.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE NOT o.DLC_KEY IS NULL AND r.AREA > a.avg_area), room_access_major_use AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT CASE WHEN LAG(DESCRIPTION) OVER (ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME) = DESCRIPTION THEN NULL ELSE DESCRIPTION END AS major_use_description, BUILDING_ROOM, AREA, ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ROOM_KEY, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY DESCRIPTION, ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT ramu.major_use_description, ramu.BUILDING_ROOM, ramu.AREA, ramu.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ramu.window_column FROM room_access_major_use AS ramu JOIN org_avg_area AS oaa ON ramu.FCLT_ROOM_KEY = oaa.FCLT_ROOM_KEY AND ramu.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = oaa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY ramu.major_use_description, ramu.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TopTerms AS (SELECT ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.subject_count, ic.total_enrollment, d.DEPT_NAME AS most_subjects_department, d.subjects_in_dept FROM inner_cte1 AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS DEPT_NAME, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subjects_in_dept, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY ss.TERM_CODE ORDER BY COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS dept_rank FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss GROUP BY ss.TERM_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS d ON ic.TERM_CODE = d.TERM_CODE AND d.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.total_enrollment DESC LIMIT 5), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.TERM_CODE), DeptMaxAvgUnits AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(avg_total_units) AS max_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY max_avg_total_units DESC) SELECT tt.TERM_CODE, tt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, tt.subject_count, tt.total_enrollment, tt.most_subjects_department, tt.subjects_in_dept, dmax.max_avg_total_units FROM TopTerms AS tt LEFT JOIN DeptMaxAvgUnits AS dmax ON tt.most_subjects_department = dmax.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY tt.total_enrollment DESC, tt.TERM_CODE
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN ccc.DESIGN_UNITS >= 3 THEN scd.COURSE END) sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.COURSE_LEVEL, ic.course_count, ic.min_total_units), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY ic.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.person_count, ic.min_mit_id), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.COURSE_LEVEL, NULL AS EMPLOYEE_TYPE, NULL AS person_count, NULL AS min_mit_id, NULL AS unique_office_locations, s1.course_count, s1.min_total_units, s1.courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, 'CourseStats' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS COURSE_LEVEL, s2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, s2.person_count, s2.min_mit_id, s2.unique_office_locations, NULL AS course_count, NULL AS min_total_units, NULL AS courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, 'StudentStats' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, COURSE_LEVEL, EMPLOYEE_TYPE, person_count, min_mit_id, unique_office_locations, course_count, min_total_units, courses_with_design_units_3_or_more, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source

SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), cte2.SUBJECT_CODE, cte2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, cte2.window_column AS MIN_ENROLLED_STUDENTS_OVER_SUBJECT_CODE_2017JA, cte2.SCHOOL_NAME, cte2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER FROM cte1 JOIN cte2 ON s.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category, i.SUBJECT_ID FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND s.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' ORDER BY i.reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10), top_departments AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students, year_stats.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC AS Peak_Year_Desc, year_stats.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Total_Enrolled_Students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY Total_Enrolled_Students DESC LIMIT 5) AS dept_stats LEFT JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS Year_Enrolled_Students, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY SUM(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) DESC) AS rn FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS year_stats ON dept_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = year_stats.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND year_stats.rn = 1 ORDER BY dept_stats.Total_Enrolled_Students DESC) SELECT sd.SUBJECT_TITLE, sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.reserved_materials, sd.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, sd.demand_category, td.Total_Enrolled_Students, td.Peak_Year_Desc, td.Year_Enrolled_Students FROM subject_demand AS sd LEFT JOIN top_departments AS td ON sd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = td.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY sd.reserved_materials DESC

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte GROUP BY SUBJECT_TITLE, TERM_CODE, TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, TOTAL_UNITS) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrolled_students, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TOTAL_UNITS FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.max_enrolled_students DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 10 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(t.START_DATE) AS earliest_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN TIME_DAY AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ic.activity_count, ic.earliest_start_date, ac.Most_Common_Activity_Title, ac.Activity_Title_Count FROM (SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY activity_count DESC LIMIT 5) AS ic LEFT JOIN (SELECT d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE AS Most_Common_Activity_Title, COUNT(*) AS Activity_Title_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS ac ON ic.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = ac.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND ic.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = ac.ENROLLMENT_TYPE AND ac.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.activity_count DESC) SELECT s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.activity_count, s2.earliest_start_date, s2.Most_Common_Activity_Title, s2.Activity_Title_Count FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = s2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = s2.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY s2.activity_count DESC, s1.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH ActivityStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t2.TERM_START_DATE, t0.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, Activity_Counts.Total_Activities FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Total_Activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' GROUP BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS Activity_Counts ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC = Activity_Counts.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CategorySponsorStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.TERM_START_DATE, a.Total_Activities, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, c.avg_fee, c.total_activities FROM ActivityStats AS a JOIN CategorySponsorStats AS c ON a.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY AND a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE = c.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, c.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE) SELECT c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, AVG(d.FEE) AS avg_fee, COUNT(d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS total_activities FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY, s1.avg_fee, s1.total_activities, s2.highest_max_enrollment FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = s2.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME WHERE s2.highest_max_enrollment > 20 ORDER BY s1.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, s1.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, s1.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY
WITH CategoryMaxEnrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, MAX(MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS highest_max_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY IAP_CATEGORY_NAME), TopSubjectsByMaterials AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(td.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS material_count, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.material_count, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.material_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT cme.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cme.highest_max_enrollment, tsbm.SUBJECT_TITLE, tsbm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tsbm.material_count, tsbm.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM CategoryMaxEnrollment AS cme CROSS JOIN TopSubjectsByMaterials AS tsbm
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TOTAL_UNITS, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_CODE, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.TOTAL_UNITS, s2.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s2.deviation_from_dept_avg FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND s1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, org_counts.Total_Rooms, inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT BUILDING_ROOM) AS Total_Rooms FROM (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) AS sub GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS org_counts ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = org_counts.ORGANIZATION_NAME), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, COUNT(DISTINCT su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count, MIN(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_org_number, su.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fodk.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE fo.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 50000 GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION, su.SPACE_UNIT, su.DLC_KEY) SELECT ic.ORGANIZATION, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.space_unit_count, ic.min_org_number, d.org_count, ic.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT ORGANIZATION) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION GROUP BY DLC_KEY) AS d ON ic.DLC_KEY = d.DLC_KEY) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.Total_Rooms, s2.ORGANIZATION, s2.SPACE_UNIT, s2.space_unit_count, s2.min_org_number, s2.org_count FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS fodk ON s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fodk.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON fodk.DLC_KEY = s2.DLC_KEY
WITH DeptRoomGeomMean AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(fr.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area, AVG(fr.AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS ed ON fr.BUILDING_ROOM = ed.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE fr.AREA > 0 GROUP BY ed.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE UPPER(ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME) LIKE 'D%' AND ic.avg_area >= 100 ORDER BY ic.geometric_mean_area DESC), DeptHierarchyStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS min_org_unit_id FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m ON f.DLC_KEY = m.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON m.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY WHERE m.HIERARCHY_TYPE = 'Standard Hierarchy' AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS' GROUP BY h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, inner_cte.org_count, inner_cte.min_org_unit_id, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AND h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL = 'DEPARTMENTS') SELECT dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, dh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dh.org_count, dh.min_org_unit_id, dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, drgm.geometric_mean_area FROM DeptHierarchyStats AS dh JOIN DeptRoomGeomMean AS drgm ON dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = drgm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY dh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, drgm.geometric_mean_area DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA, o.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 40), dept_avg AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), rooms_above_avg AS (SELECT i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte1 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS a ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.AREA > a.avg_area), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area'), provost_depts AS (SELECT inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, inner_cte2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte2.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, inner_cte2.window_column, t2.DLC_NAME, inner_cte2.DLC_KEY FROM inner_cte2 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON inner_cte2.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY) SELECT p.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, p.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, p.window_column, p.DLC_NAME, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.AREA FROM provost_depts AS p JOIN rooms_above_avg AS r ON p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND p.DLC_KEY = r.DLC_KEY ORDER BY p.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.AREA DESC
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.max_total_units, i.SCHOOL_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.SCHOOL_NAME = s.SCHOOL_NAME JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND c.TOTAL_UNITS = i.max_total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2022SU') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.TOTAL_UNITS DESC) SELECT subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.max_total_units, subq1.SCHOOL_NAME, subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.SUBJECT_ID, subq2.TOTAL_UNITS, subq2.window_column FROM subq1 JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON subq1.SUBJECT_CODE = ccc.SUBJECT_CODE AND subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN subq2 ON ccc.SUBJECT_ID = subq2.SUBJECT_ID
WITH org_dept_max_hr_unit AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) AS highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), provost_dept_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, VARIANCE(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_variance, STDDEV(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_key_stddev FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME) SELECT m.DLC_NAME, AVG(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS avg_org_key, MAX(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS max_org_key, COUNT(DISTINCT m2.DLC_CODE) AS unique_lvl3_dlc_codes FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m2 ON m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE = m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE AND m2.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME ORDER BY avg_org_key DESC) SELECT p.DLC_NAME, p.avg_org_key, p.max_org_key, p.unique_lvl3_dlc_codes, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.highest_hr_org_unit_id FROM provost_dept_stats AS p JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON p.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME JOIN org_dept_max_hr_unit AS o ON h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY p.avg_org_key DESC
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.BUILDING_ROOM ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.FLOOR = 2 AND t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), subq1 AS (SELECT SPACE_UNIT, MAX(window_column) AS max_window_row_number, SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_CODE), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), dept_avg AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte2 GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), subq2 AS (SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation, i.SPACE_UNIT_CODE FROM inner_cte2 AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.max_window_row_number, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.access_level_deviation FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = s2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SPACE_UNIT, s2.BUILDING_ROOM
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(ccs2.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects_offered FROM inner_cte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs2 ON ccs2.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ccs2.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_lecture_units, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, NULL AS max_lecture_units, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS num_subjects_offered, 'Subject' AS Source FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_CODE, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS window_column, s2.max_lecture_units, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s2.num_subjects_offered, 'Department' AS Source FROM Subquery2 AS s2) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column, max_lecture_units, TERM_START_DATE, num_subjects_offered, Source FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Source, SUBJECT_CODE

SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.reserved_materials, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, CASE WHEN i.reserved_materials > s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_DEMAND' WHEN i.reserved_materials < s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_DEMAND' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS demand_category, s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON i.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS sad JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON sad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT AS ccc ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.min_budget_code, inner_cte.total_units_sum, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.reserved_materials, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.demand_category, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS min_budget_code, NULL AS total_units_sum, NULL AS unique_courses, 'Subject' AS Source FROM subq1 AS s1 WHERE s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE IN (SELECT DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM subq2) UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS reserved_materials, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS demand_category, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.min_budget_code, s2.total_units_sum, s2.unique_courses, 'Department' AS Source FROM subq2 AS s2 WHERE s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE IN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM subq1)) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults ORDER BY Source, COALESCE(SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME)

WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units, SUM(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY = so.SUBJECT_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.SUBJECT_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.offering_count, inner_cte.total_units), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, a.avg_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < a.avg_enrolled * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.offering_count, s1.total_units, s1.total_enrolled_students, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.avg_enrolled, s2.enrollment_category FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_KEY

ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS SUBQ1_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.SECTION_ID = 0 AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S') SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t3.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.SUBQ1_DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t3 ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = t3.TERM_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS avg_cte ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = avg_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE avg_cte.avg_enrollment >= 20) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.TERM_START_DATE, s1.window_column, s2.total_enrollment, 'Subject' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME UNION ALL SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS TERM_START_DATE, NULL AS window_column, s2.total_enrollment, 'Department' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME, Reason

5), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_students), geom_mean_cte AS (SELECT AND ic2.rn = 1 GROUP BY ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SCHOOL_NAME, ic2.SUBJECT_ID, ic2.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER ORDER BY Subject_Count DESC LIMIT 5) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, WITH geometric_mean_units AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), subject_enrollment AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), dept_avg AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM subject_enrollment GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, gm.geometric_mean_total_units, se.SUBJECT_ID, se.SUBJECT_TITLE, se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, se.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, da.avg_enrollment, CASE WHEN se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > da.avg_enrollment * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN se.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < da.avg_enrollment * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM geometric_mean_units AS gm JOIN subject_enrollment AS se ON gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME = se.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN dept_avg AS da ON se.DEPARTMENT_NAME = da.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY gm.DEPARTMENT_NAME, gm.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, se.SUBJECT_ID

WITH rq_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT tso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units), current_term_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS Total_Subjects FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT rq.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, rq.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS subject_count FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON so.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE, ccso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_ID, ccso.TERM_CODE FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE ccso.GRADE_RULE_DESC = 'Not repeatable for credit' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' ORDER BY icte.subject_count DESC, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, l.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, i.window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON i.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID AND i.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE) SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s1.subject_count, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.ISBN, s2.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2.window_column FROM Subquery1 AS s1 JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID AND s1.TERM_CODE = s2.TERM_CODE ORDER BY s1.subject_count DESC, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.SUBJECT_CODE, s2.window_column
WITH Subquery1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.SPACE_USAGE, t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.SPACE_UNIT, AVG(t1.FLOOR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE ORDER BY t1.FLOOR) AS avg_floor FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t1 ON t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = t1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1) SELECT ic.BUILDING_ROOM, ic.FLOOR, ic.SPACE_USAGE, ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, ic.SPACE_UNIT, ic.avg_floor, cnt.total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT SPACE_UNIT_CODE, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS cnt ON ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = cnt.SPACE_UNIT_CODE), Subquery2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.ACCESS_LEVEL FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), dept_avg AS (SELECT HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(ACCESS_LEVEL) AS avg_access_level FROM inner_cte GROUP BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, (i.ACCESS_LEVEL - d.avg_access_level) AS access_level_deviation FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.FLOOR, s1.SPACE_USAGE, s1.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s1.SPACE_UNIT, s1.avg_floor, s1.total_rooms, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS access_level_deviation, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM Subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT_CODE, NULL AS SPACE_UNIT, NULL AS avg_floor, NULL AS total_rooms, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.access_level_deviation, 'Floor2' AS Reason FROM Subquery2 AS s2 ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte1 AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, COUNT(DISTINCT TIP_DETAIL.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL ON ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE = TIP_DETAIL.TERM_CODE WHERE NOT ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_STATUS IS NULL AND TIP_DETAIL.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY <> 'NM' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), cte1 AS (SELECT inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte1.unique_subject_count FROM inner_cte1 JOIN (SELECT AVG(unique_subject_count) AS avg_unique_subjects FROM inner_cte1) AS avg_cte ON inner_cte1.unique_subject_count > avg_cte.avg_unique_subjects), inner_cte2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), cte2 AS (SELECT inner_cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte2.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte2.window_column, avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students, CASE WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS < avg_stats.avg_enrolled_students * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte2 JOIN (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS avg_stats ON avg_stats.TERM_CODE = '2012SU') SELECT cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE, cte2.SUBJECT_ID, cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cte2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cte2.window_column, cte2.avg_enrolled_students, cte2.enrollment_category, cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, cte1.unique_subject_count FROM cte2 JOIN cte1 ON cte2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cte1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY cte2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, cte2.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH EngineeringStudents AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT COUNT(*) AS engineering_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%') SELECT msd.FULL_NAME, msd.EMAIL_ADDRESS, sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = msd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LIKE '%Engineering%'), Subjects2025FA AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS min_enrolled_students_per_dept, t0.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA') SELECT SUBJECT_ID, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, TERM_DESCRIPTION, ACADEMIC_YEAR, TERM_START_DATE, TERM_END_DATE, TERM_PARAMETER, min_enrolled_students_per_dept, OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM inner_cte) SELECT es.FULL_NAME, es.EMAIL_ADDRESS, s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s.TERM_START_DATE, s.TERM_END_DATE, s.TERM_PARAMETER, s.min_enrolled_students_per_dept, s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM EngineeringStudents AS es JOIN Subjects2025FA AS s ON es.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY es.FULL_NAME, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH max_avg_enrollment AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'N' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, AVG(SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) AS subq GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY max_avg_subject_enrollment DESC), term_window_stats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' AND t1.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_PREVIOUS_TERM') SELECT inner_cte.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.window_column, Total_Terms.Total_Terms_Per_Year, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT t2.TERM_CODE) AS Total_Terms_Per_Year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 GROUP BY t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS Total_Terms ON inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = Total_Terms.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT tws.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY, tws.TERM_DESCRIPTION, tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE, tws.TERM_END_DATE, tws.window_column, tws.Total_Terms_Per_Year, mae.max_avg_subject_enrollment FROM term_window_stats AS tws JOIN max_avg_enrollment AS mae ON tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR = mae.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY tws.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, tws.TERM_START_DATE
WITH subq1 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.TOTAL_UNITS >= 6) SELECT SUBJECT_CODE, SUBJECT_TITLE, DEPARTMENT_NAME, window_column FROM inner_cte WHERE window_column > 12 ORDER BY SUBJECT_CODE), subq2 AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(sp.MIT_ID) AS person_count, MIN(sp.MIT_ID) AS min_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id, GROUP_CONCAT(DISTINCT sp.OFFICE_LOCATION) AS unique_office_locations FROM inner_cte JOIN SE_PERSON AS sp ON sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' GROUP BY inner_cte.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.person_count, inner_cte.min_mit_id) SELECT subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq1.SUBJECT_TITLE, subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, subq1.window_column, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE, subq2.person_count, subq2.min_mit_id, subq2.unique_office_locations FROM subq1 JOIN subq2 ON subq1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY subq1.SUBJECT_CODE, subq2.EMPLOYEE_TYPE

t1.TERM_CODE), YearEnrollmentStats AS (WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment > avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN inner_cte.geometric_mean_enrollment < avg_stats.avg_geometric_mean * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte CROSS JOIN (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_enrollment) AS avg_geometric_mean FROM inner_cte) AS avg_stats) SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), DepartmentSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, MAX(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_subject_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, lrm.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, lrm.TERM_CODE, lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, lrm.TERM_DESCRIPTION, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, lrm.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, lrm.window_column, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, dss.max_subject_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS lrm JOIN DepartmentSubjectStats AS dss ON lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR = dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY lrm.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER), Subquery3 AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, MAX(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS max_enrolled_students FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_ID, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s1.window_column, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, s3.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s2.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN Subquery3 AS s3 ON s3.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = cso.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND s3.COURSE_NUMBER = cso.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY s1.SUBJECT_ID, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, d.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS dense_rank_material_status, s.SUBJECT_ID, t.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON s.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p ON t.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS d ON l.SUBJECT_ID = d.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025' AND l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND d.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.subject_rank_in_dept, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, i.dense_rank_material_status, t.TERM_START_DATE, t.TERM_END_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON i.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE ORDER BY i.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, i.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME), TermJoin AS (SELECT t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY GROUP BY t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, d.TERM_CODE, d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN TermJoin AS tj ON dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tj.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON tj.ACTIVITY_TITLE = ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE AND tj.SPONSOR_NAME = ass.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME, inner_cte.activity_count, inner_cte.min_fee, s.SPONSOR_TYPE FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME = s.SPONSOR_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.SPONSOR_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectRanks AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.SUBJECT_ID, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), CourseEnrollments AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT sr.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ce.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM SubjectRanks AS sr JOIN CourseEnrollments AS ce ON sr.SUBJECT_ID = ce.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > (SELECT AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.course_count, inner_cte.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, ccat.HASS_ATTRIBUTE_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.TERM_CODE FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) AS sws ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccat ON sws.SUBJECT_CODE = ccat.SUBJECT_CODE AND sws.TERM_CODE = ccat.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sws.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), DepartmentEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.window_column, de.total_enrollment FROM SubjectStats AS ss JOIN DepartmentEnrollment AS de ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = de.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = de.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(window_column) AS highest_avg_window_enrollment, MAX(total_enrollment) AS total_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), dept_2022fa_stats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, COUNT(*) AS subject_count, at2.TERM_START_DATE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, d22.max_lecture_units, d22.TERM_START_DATE, d22.subject_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_2022fa_stats AS d22 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE

td.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND td.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE at.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ts.material_count, NULL AS OFFER_DEPT_NAME, NULL AS RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS TOTAL_UNITS, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE, 'TopSubjects' AS Reason, ts.SUBJECT_ID FROM TopSubjects AS ts UNION ALL SELECT s2014.SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS material_count, s2014.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2014.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s2014.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2014.TOTAL_UNITS, s2014.window_column, NULL AS SCHOOL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE, 'Subjects2014FA' AS Reason, s2014.SUBJECT_ID FROM Subjects2014FA AS s2014) SELECT * FROM CombinedSubjects) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.material_count, ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.TOTAL_UNITS, ic.window_column, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, ad.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER AS DEPARTMENT_PHONE, ic.Reason FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS ad ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ad.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER WITH inner_cte AS (WITH department_units_stats AS (SELECT SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(CCSO.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS SCD JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS CCSO ON SCD.COURSE = CCSO.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE CCSO.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 GROUP BY SCD.DEPARTMENT_NAME), engineering_degree_courses AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, ccs.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_CODE = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON t1.COURSE = ccs.SUBJECT_CODE AND ccs.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT edc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, edc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, edc.window_column, edc.TOTAL_UNITS, dus.avg_units FROM engineering_degree_courses AS edc LEFT JOIN department_units_stats AS dus ON edc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dus.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT COURSE_DESCRIPTION, DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, window_column, avg_units, TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN TOTAL_UNITS > avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN TOTAL_UNITS < avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.DEPARTMENT_CODE HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50), DeptUnitsStats AS (SELECT SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG ON SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE = CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE NOT CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.SUBJECT_TITLE IS NULL AND CIS_COURSE_CATALOG.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SIS_DEPARTMENT.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT e.DEPARTMENT_NAME, e.DEPARTMENT_CODE, e.total_enrollment, u.avg_units FROM DeptEnrollment AS e JOIN DeptUnitsStats AS u ON e.DEPARTMENT_CODE = u.DEPARTMENT_CODE), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(avg_units) AS overall_avg_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.total_enrollment, i.avg_units, CASE WHEN i.avg_units > o.overall_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_LOAD' WHEN i.avg_units < o.overall_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_LOAD' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS load_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS o ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME
