WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(r.AREA))) AS geometric_mean_area FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 0 GROUP BY o.DLC_KEY, o.DLC_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, AVG(i.geometric_mean_area) AS avg_geometric_mean_area FROM inner_cte AS i GROUP BY i.DLC_NAME HAVING AVG(i.geometric_mean_area) > (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_area) FROM inner_cte)
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_column AS room_area_sum, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, AVG(icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS org_key_avg, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON o.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column, t1.TERM_START_DATE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), AvgEnrolled AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.window_column AS math_window_column, p.TERM_START_DATE, p.CALENDAR_DATE, p.DAY_OF_WEEK, p.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN PreviousTerms AS p ON i.TERM_CODE = p.TERM_CODE JOIN AvgEnrolled AS a ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = a.ACADEMIC_YEAR WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > a.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.COURSE_NUMBER, p.TERM_START_DATE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgSuperviseeStats AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgResearchVolume AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, SUM(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME) AS total_research_volume FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.RESEARCH_VOLUME > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, os.geometric_mean_supervisees, orv.total_research_volume FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN OrgSuperviseeStats AS os ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN OrgResearchVolume AS orv ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = orv.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgInfo AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DLC_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomInfo AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, (r.AREA - r.min_area_per_major_use) AS area_deviation FROM OrgInfo AS o JOIN RoomInfo AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_ID, inner_cte.DLC_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR, inner_cte.area_deviation FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON inner_cte.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.SUBJECT_ID, lso.SUBJECT_TITLE FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 0) SELECT ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, dept_counts.Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT SUBJECT_ID) AS Total_Subjects FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) AS dept_counts ON ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dept_counts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY ic.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d2 WHERE d2.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY) AS avg_max_enrollment_in_category FROM inner_cte AS i WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > (SELECT AVG(MAX_ENROLLMENT) FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL) ORDER BY i.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, i.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL), space_avg AS (SELECT s.DLC_KEY, AVG(s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT AS s WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY s.DLC_KEY), overall_avg AS (SELECT AVG(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS overall_avg_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT WHERE SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, sa.avg_space_unit_key, CASE WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key > oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 1.2 THEN 'LARGE_SPACE' WHEN sa.avg_space_unit_key < oa.overall_avg_space_unit_key * 0.8 THEN 'SMALL_SPACE' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS space_size_category FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN space_avg AS sa ON d.DLC_KEY = sa.DLC_KEY CROSS JOIN overall_avg AS oa ORDER BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, mat_count.num_materials, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s2.TERM_CODE, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.ISBN, s2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s2.max_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ISBN, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE NOT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IS NULL AND t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 0) AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = s2.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(DISTINCT t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY) AS num_materials FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0d ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t0d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_TITLE = t2.SUBJECT_TITLE AND t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t0 ON t2.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY WHERE t0d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS mat_count ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = mat_count.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND icte.SUBJECT_TITLE = mat_count.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrollment FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL ON COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE AND COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID = TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.SUBJECT_ID WHERE COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED.DEPARTMENT_NAME), MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS (SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(avg_enrollment) AS max_avg_enrollment FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS m ON i.ACADEMIC_YEAR = m.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND i.avg_enrollment = m.max_avg_enrollment), MinYearTotalUnits AS (SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units_sum FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrm.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrm.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrm.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y') SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.avg_enrollment, t.min_academic_year, t.total_units_sum FROM MaxDeptAvgEnrollment AS m CROSS JOIN MinYearTotalUnits AS t ORDER BY m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollments FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS p JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON p.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE p.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 10) SELECT de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, de.total_enrollments, lss.COURSE_NUMBER, lss.subject_count, lss.min_total_units, lss.unique_faculty_count FROM inner_cte AS de JOIN (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, COUNT(DISTINCT so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_MIT_ID) AS unique_faculty_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS so ON l.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) AS lss ON de.DEPARTMENT_NAME = lss.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY de.DEPARTMENT_NAME, lss.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT scd.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(ccc.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON scd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccc.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE scd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ccc.TOTAL_UNITS > 6 GROUP BY scd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, scd.COURSE_LEVEL) SELECT cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS cs JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN (SELECT s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS reserved_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY reserved_materials DESC LIMIT 10) AS ts ON sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND sos.SUBJECT_TITLE = ts.SUBJECT_TITLE GROUP BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, cs.course_count, cs.min_total_units, ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.reserved_materials ORDER BY cs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, cs.COURSE_LEVEL, ts.reserved_materials DESC, avg_enrolled_students DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss WHERE ss.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.TOTAL_UNITS, CASE WHEN ss.TOTAL_UNITS > dau.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ss.TOTAL_UNITS < dau.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE_UNIT' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = '2009SP' JOIN dept_avg_units AS dau ON ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH SubjectLectureUnits AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), ActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), CombinedResults AS (SELECT s.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.window_column, a.total_active_grad_students FROM SubjectLectureUnits AS s JOIN ActiveGradStudents AS a ON s.DEPARTMENT_NAME = a.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedResults), DeptMaxTotalUnits AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.window_column, i.total_active_grad_students, d.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptMaxTotalUnits AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS hr_org_unit_title_from_hr, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS hr_org_unit_level_from_hr FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON o.DLC_NAME = h.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgLevel5Details AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), MaxSpaceUnitKey AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, MAX(SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS max_space_unit_key FROM SPACE_UNIT GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column, m.max_space_unit_key FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN OrgLevel5Details AS o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN MaxSpaceUnitKey AS m ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = m.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA'), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, d.avg_enrolled FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.avg_enrolled ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, bh.BUILDING_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, BuildingRoomTotals.total_area FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = f.ORGANIZATION_NAME JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS r ON f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS bh ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY JOIN (SELECT bh.BUILDING_NAME, SUM(r.AREA) AS total_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS bh ON r.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = bh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 GROUP BY bh.BUILDING_NAME) AS BuildingRoomTotals ON bh.BUILDING_NAME = BuildingRoomTotals.BUILDING_NAME WHERE r.AREA > 100 ORDER BY icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, bh.BUILDING_NAME, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC), space_unit_402100 AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_402100 AS s LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees AS o ON s.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE geometric_mean_supervisees > (SELECT AVG(NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES) FROM SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE WHERE NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0)
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptOrgStats AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME), OrgSuperviseeGeomMean AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, d.ORGANIZATION_NAME, d.organization_count, d.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM DeptOrgStats AS d JOIN OrgSuperviseeGeomMean AS o ON d.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.geometric_mean_supervisees, COALESCE(SUM(ssu.SQFT), 0) AS total_supervisee_sqft FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME = fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE AS ssu ON su.DLC_KEY = ssu.DEPT_NAMES GROUP BY inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.organization_count, inner_cte.min_organization_number, inner_cte.geometric_mean_supervisees ORDER BY inner_cte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME AS dept_name_1 FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), dept_2022fa_stats AS (SELECT ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) AS max_lecture_units, at2.TERM_START_DATE, COUNT(DISTINCT ccs.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count_2022fa FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at2 ON td.TERM_CODE = at2.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccs ON at2.TERM_CODE = ccs.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE at2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' GROUP BY ccs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at2.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ccs.LECTURE_UNITS) > 3) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, d22.max_lecture_units, d22.TERM_START_DATE, d22.subject_count_2022fa FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_2022fa_stats AS d22 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d22.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, dtm.total_tip_materials, ROUND(CAST(icte.total_enrollment AS REAL) / NULLIF(icte.subject_count, 0), 2) AS Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject, ROUND(CAST(icte.total_enrollment AS REAL) / NULLIF(dtm.total_tip_materials, 0), 2) AS Enrollment_per_TipMaterial FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) AS dtm ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dtm.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY Avg_Enrollment_per_Subject DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t3 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t3.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2025FA' AND t3.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering') SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS highest_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_NUMBER, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.COURSE_NUMBER) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ic.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ic.window_column AS math_window_column, pt.TERM_START_DATE, pt.CALENDAR_DATE, pt.DAY_OF_WEEK, pt.window_column AS previous_terms_window_column, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, lso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN PreviousTerms AS pt ON ic.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso ON ic.COURSE_NUMBER = lso.COURSE_NUMBER AND ic.TERM_CODE = lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY ic.COURSE_NUMBER, pt.TERM_START_DATE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100), org_space_counts AS (SELECT t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ASSIGNABLE, COUNT(t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS space_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = 402100 GROUP BY t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.ASSIGNABLE), org_hr_dept_counts AS (SELECT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS hr_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON fo.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), org_hr_dept_ranked AS (SELECT ohdc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, ohdc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohdc.hr_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ohdc.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY ohdc.hr_unit_count DESC) AS dept_rank FROM org_hr_dept_counts AS ohdc) SELECT osc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, osc.space_unit_count, osc.ASSIGNABLE, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Frequent_HR_Department, ohr.hr_unit_count AS HR_Unit_Count FROM org_space_counts AS osc LEFT JOIN org_hr_dept_ranked AS ohr ON osc.ORGANIZATION_NAME = ohr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AND ohr.dept_rank = 1 ORDER BY osc.space_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH CurrentTermSummary AS (SELECT atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY atp.TERM_CODE, atp.TERM_DESCRIPTION, at.ACADEMIC_YEAR), CurrentTermSubjects AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_PARAMETER = 'SIS_CURRENT_TERM') SELECT cts.TERM_CODE, cts.TERM_DESCRIPTION, cts.ACADEMIC_YEAR, cts.subject_count, cts.total_enrollment, csub.SUBJECT_TITLE, csub.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, csub.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, csub.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, csub.window_column, csub.SUBJECT_ID FROM CurrentTermSummary AS cts JOIN CurrentTermSubjects AS csub ON cts.TERM_CODE = csub.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.total_enrollment, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, inner_cte.window_column, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT l.SUBJECT_ID, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, COUNT(CASE WHEN ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' THEN 1 END) AS rq_material_count, AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' GROUP BY ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE HAVING COUNT(CASE WHEN ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ' THEN 1 END) >= 5 AND AVG(ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10 ORDER BY rq_material_count DESC, avg_enrolled_students DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), ActivitySponsorStats AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS activity_count, MIN(d.FEE) AS min_fee, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPONSOR_TYPE) AS sponsor_type_count, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SPONSOR_KEY JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON d.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE d.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, s.SPONSOR_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.subject_count, icte.min_total_units, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME, ass.activity_count, ass.min_fee, ass.sponsor_type_count FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN ActivitySponsorStats AS ass ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ass.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ass.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ass.SPONSOR_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, s.SESSION_TITLE, s.SESSION_LOCATION, s.SESSION_DATE, s.SESSION_START_TIME, s.SESSION_END_TIME, MIN(s.SESSION_START_TIME) OVER (PARTITION BY s.SESSION_LOCATION ORDER BY s.SESSION_LOCATION) AS min_start_time_per_location, d.TERM_CODE FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION AS s ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY = s.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY WHERE d.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND d.IS_CANCELLED = 'N') SELECT i.ACTIVITY_TITLE, i.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.MAX_ENROLLMENT, i.SESSION_TITLE, i.SESSION_LOCATION, i.SESSION_DATE, i.SESSION_START_TIME, i.SESSION_END_TIME, i.min_start_time_per_location, t2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, CASE WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 50 THEN 'HIGH_CAPACITY' WHEN i.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 25 THEN 'LOW_CAPACITY' ELSE 'MEDIUM_CAPACITY' END AS capacity_category FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN TIME_DAY AS t0 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t2 ON i.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT >= 20 ORDER BY i.SESSION_LOCATION

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC) SELECT m.ACADEMIC_YEAR, m.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, m.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, d.geometric_mean_degree_year FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS m LEFT JOIN GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS d ON m.ACADEMIC_YEAR = d.ACADEMIC_YEAR), avg_materials AS (SELECT AVG(geometric_mean_materials_per_subject) AS avg_geom_materials FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, i.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, i.geometric_mean_degree_year, CASE WHEN i.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject > a.avg_geom_materials * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_PERFORMER' WHEN i.geometric_mean_materials_per_subject < a.avg_geom_materials * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_PERFORMER' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS performance_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_materials AS a ORDER BY i.ACADEMIC_YEAR

FROM SchoolAreaTotals ORDER BY ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, SPACE_UNIT_CODE

avg_record_count_across_terms FROM (SELECT t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') AS sub GROUP BY ACADEMIC_YEAR) SELECT icte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, (icte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT - aat.avg_record_count_across_terms) AS deviation_from_academic_year_avg FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN avg_across_terms AS aat ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = aat.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY icte.TERM_CODE, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(t2.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY t0.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sc.SUBJECT_CODE, sc.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, scd.GRADUATE_LEVEL, Total_Courses.Total_Courses, COALESCE(SubjectsWithTextbooks.Subjects_With_Textbooks, 0) AS Subjects_With_Textbooks_2022_12units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN (SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT COURSE_NUMBER) AS Total_Courses FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS sc ON scd.COURSE = sc.COURSE_NUMBER GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS Total_Courses ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = Total_Courses.DEPARTMENT_NAME LEFT JOIN (SELECT s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT s1.SUBJECT_CODE OR '-' OR s1.SUBJECT_NUMBER) AS Subjects_With_Textbooks FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON s1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE AND s1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY IN ('RQ', 'EO') GROUP BY s1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS SubjectsWithTextbooks ON sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = SubjectsWithTextbooks.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name, su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, su.DLC_KEY, su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, fo.DLC_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME FROM SPACE_UNIT AS su JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE NOT su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE IS NULL), org_counts AS (SELECT ic.space_unit_name, COUNT(DISTINCT ic.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, ic.DLC_NAME FROM inner_cte AS ic GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.DLC_NAME), org_rank AS (SELECT ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) AS space_unit_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY ic.space_unit_name ORDER BY COUNT(ic.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) DESC) AS org_rank FROM inner_cte AS ic WHERE NOT ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL GROUP BY ic.space_unit_name, ic.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT oc.space_unit_name, oc.org_count AS total_organization_count, oc.DLC_NAME, orr.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS most_represented_organization, orr.space_unit_count AS space_unit_count_for_organization FROM org_counts AS oc LEFT JOIN org_rank AS orr ON oc.space_unit_name = orr.space_unit_name AND orr.org_rank = 1 ORDER BY oc.org_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS num_subjects FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON scd.COURSE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE ccso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR = 'Y' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ssc.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY num_subjects DESC LIMIT 5), dept_avg_units AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' GROUP BY ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE), subject_offerings AS (SELECT ssc.DEPARTMENT_CODE, sos.SUBJECT_TITLE, sos.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, sos.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = scd.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON scd.COURSE = sos.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE sos.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND sos.TOTAL_UNITS > 10) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.num_subjects, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, so.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, (so.TOTAL_UNITS - dau.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN subject_offerings AS so ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = so.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN dept_avg_units AS dau ON ic.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dau.DEPARTMENT_CODE ORDER BY ic.num_subjects DESC, so.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dmu.max_total_units, dmu.SCHOOL_NAME, esc.FULL_NAME, esc.EMAIL_ADDRESS, esc.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, esc.COURSE_LEVEL, esc.window_column FROM (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, s.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6) AS dmu JOIN (SELECT t2.FULL_NAME, t2.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.COURSE_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.COURSE_LEVEL ORDER BY t2.LAST_NAME) AS window_column FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci') AS esc ON dmu.DEPARTMENT_NAME = esc.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.max_total_units, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL, CASE WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'U' THEN 'Undergraduate' WHEN inner_cte.COURSE_LEVEL = 'G' THEN 'Graduate' ELSE 'Other' END AS COURSE_TYPE, CASE WHEN inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS LIKE '%@mit.edu' THEN 'MIT_EMAIL' ELSE 'NON_MIT_EMAIL' END AS EMAIL_TYPE, inner_cte.window_column FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), DeptStats AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME FROM OrgStats AS o JOIN DeptStats AS d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.org_window_column, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, icte.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, CASE WHEN icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY > icte.org_window_column * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_ORG_KEY' WHEN icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY < icte.org_window_column * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_ORG_KEY' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS org_key_category FROM inner_cte AS icte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t1.LECTURE_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.GRADE_TYPE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA'), ActiveGradStudentStats AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING COUNT(*) > 0) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.window_column, ags.total_active_grad_students, CASE WHEN ags.total_active_grad_students > 10 THEN 'LARGE' WHEN ags.total_active_grad_students < 5 THEN 'SMALL' ELSE 'MEDIUM' END AS department_size_category FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN ActiveGradStudentStats AS ags ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ags.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY ic.SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, subq2.offered_subject_count, subq2.min_enrolled_students, inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS offered_subject_count, MIN(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_enrolled_students FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON s.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 3 GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SCHOOL_NAME) AS subq2 ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = subq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND inner_cte.SCHOOL_NAME = subq2.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY inner_cte.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 AS sq2 JOIN Subquery1 AS sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.offering_count, icte.total_units, icte.window_column, AVG(so.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON icte.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' GROUP BY icte.SUBJECT_KEY, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.offering_count, icte.total_units, icte.window_column ORDER BY icte.total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.SPACE_UNIT, t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT cr.ORGANIZATION_NAME, cr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, cr.DESCRIPTION, cr.SPACE_UNIT, cr.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, cr.org_window_column, cr.BUILDING_ROOM, cr.SPACE_USAGE, cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, cr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, cr.room_window_column, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM CombinedResults AS cr JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON cr.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = h.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID) SELECT * FROM inner_cte ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS organization_description FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH RoomStats AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.AREA ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_avg_area FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 300), ProvostDepts AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 INNER JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area') SELECT rs.BUILDING_ROOM, rs.FLOOR, rs.MAJOR_USE_DESC, rs.ORGANIZATION_NAME, rs.DLC_KEY, rs.window_avg_area, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, pd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, pd.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, pd.window_column FROM RoomStats AS rs JOIN ProvostDepts AS pd ON rs.DLC_KEY = pd.DLC_KEY) SELECT icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.FLOOR, icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, icte.window_avg_area, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.ORG_HIER_SCHOOL_AREA_NAME, icte.window_column, hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG AS DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME AS DEPT_HIERARCHY_LVL3_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS hou ON icte.DLC_KEY = hou.DLC_KEY AND icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE = hou.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh ON icte.DLC_KEY = mdh.DLC_KEY ORDER BY icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptWindowed AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL), SpaceUnitWindowed AS (SELECT t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t3.DESCRIPTION, SUM(t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE ORDER BY t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_sum, t2.DLC_KEY, t0.WAREHOUSE_LOAD_DATE FROM SPACE_UNIT AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t3 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t3.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000) SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS spaceunit_hr_department_name, s.DESCRIPTION AS fclt_org_description, s.window_sum FROM DeptWindowed AS d JOIN SpaceUnitWindowed AS s ON d.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE window_sum > 200000 ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, SPACE_UNIT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostArea AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), RoomAreaSummary AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT d.DLC_NAME, d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, d.org_count, d.min_level3_code, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, r.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM DeptProvostArea AS d JOIN RoomAreaSummary AS r ON d.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), MajorUseAvg AS (SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE AREA > 200 GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.MAJOR_USE_DESC, (i.window_column - m.avg_area) AS area_deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN MajorUseAvg AS m ON i.MAJOR_USE_DESC = m.MAJOR_USE_DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), category_enrollment_counts AS (SELECT cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, COUNT(*) AS EnrollmentType_Count FROM inner_cte AS cte GROUP BY cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE), category_enrollment_ranked AS (SELECT cec.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, cec.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cec.EnrollmentType_Count, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY cec.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY cec.EnrollmentType_Count DESC) AS rnk FROM category_enrollment_counts AS cec), most_frequent_enrollment_type AS (SELECT IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, ENROLLMENT_TYPE AS Most_Frequent_Enrollment_Type, EnrollmentType_Count FROM category_enrollment_ranked WHERE rnk = 1) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT, cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, mfe.Most_Frequent_Enrollment_Type, mfe.EnrollmentType_Count FROM inner_cte AS cte LEFT JOIN most_frequent_enrollment_type AS mfe ON cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = mfe.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY cte.MAX_ENROLLMENT DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subquery2 AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), DeptMaxUnits AS (SELECT t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, MAX(ss.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON t0.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND t0.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, icte.window_column, s2.subject_count, dmu.max_total_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN Subquery2 AS s2 ON icte.join_dept_name = s2.OFFER_DEPT_NAME LEFT JOIN DeptMaxUnits AS dmu ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = dmu.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY icte.SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, MIN(t2.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t0 JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t1 ON t0.COURSE = t1.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_CODE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y') SELECT icte.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SUBJECT_CODE, icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.subject_count, s2.min_total_units, cso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, cso.IS_OFFERED_THIS_YEAR FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN (SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units, ccso.SUBJECT_ID FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON ata.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE WHERE at.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS s2 ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND icte.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = cso.SUBJECT_ID AND s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR = cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptCourseSubjects AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER), EngineeringDeptTips AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) AS total_tip_materials FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON t.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON a.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND a.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.RECORD_COUNT) > 10) SELECT d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, d.COURSE_NUMBER, d.subject_count, d.min_total_units, e.total_tip_materials FROM DeptCourseSubjects AS d JOIN EngineeringDeptTips AS e ON d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = e.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND i.COURSE_NUMBER = l.COURSE_NUMBER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON l.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER, i.subject_count, i.min_total_units, i.total_tip_materials ORDER BY i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.COURSE_NUMBER
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(material_count))) AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject FROM (SELECT LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COUNT(*) AS material_count, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL WHERE LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' GROUP BY LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL.TERM_CODE) AS sub JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON sub.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.IS_REGULAR_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanDegreeYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_degree_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.DEGREE_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR))) AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = ACADEMIC_TERMS.TERM_CODE WHERE ACADEMIC_TERMS.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR > 1900 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC), CombinedGeometricMeans AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'MaterialsPerSubject' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanMaterialsPerSubject UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, NULL AS geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'DegreeYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanDegreeYear UNION ALL SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, NULL AS geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, NULL AS geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, 'FinancialAidYear' AS Reason FROM GeometricMeanFinancialAidYear) SELECT ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, geometric_mean_materials_per_subject, geometric_mean_degree_year, geometric_mean_financial_aid_year, Reason FROM CombinedGeometricMeans ORDER BY ACADEMIC_YEAR, Reason) SELECT * FROM inner_cte
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.SCHOOL_CODE ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), DeptAvg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS dept_avg FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED WHERE TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_CODE), SubjectsAboveDeptAvg AS (SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.window_column, NULL AS subject_count, '2019FA_Subject_AboveAvg' AS Reason FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN DeptAvg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > d.dept_avg), Top10Depts2014 AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE AND lso.SUBJECT_TITLE = ss.SUBJECT_TITLE JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10), Top10Depts2014Formatted AS (SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, t.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS window_column, t.subject_count, 'Top10_Dept_2014plus' AS Reason FROM Top10Depts2014 AS t) SELECT SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, window_column, subject_count, Reason FROM (SELECT * FROM SubjectsAboveDeptAvg UNION ALL SELECT * FROM Top10Depts2014Formatted) AS CombinedResults ORDER BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUBJECT_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE), SubjectWindowStats AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT dcs.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dcs.SCHOOL_NAME, dcs.course_count, dcs.min_cip_code, sws.SUBJECT_TITLE, sws.window_column, sws.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte AS dcs JOIN SubjectWindowStats AS sws ON dcs.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sws.DEPARTMENT ORDER BY dcs.course_count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats AS dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER), SubjectMaxEnroll AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER ORDER BY s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC) AS rn FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2) SELECT ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.SUBJECT_CODE, ic.subject_code_count, ic.min_dept_budget_code, ic.COURSE_NUMBER, ic.subject_count, ic.min_total_units, sme.SUBJECT_TITLE AS Top_Subject_Title, sme.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS Top_Subject_Enrollment FROM inner_cte AS ic LEFT JOIN SubjectMaxEnroll AS sme ON ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sme.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ic.COURSE_NUMBER = sme.COURSE_NUMBER AND sme.rn = 1 ORDER BY ic.subject_count DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t1.SCHOOL_NAME, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, SUM(t1.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t1.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2022FA') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, s1.SCHOOL_NAME, s1.window_column AS min_enrolled_window, s2.SUBJECT_ID, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column AS running_sum_total_units, s2.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = s2.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(inner_cte.running_sum_total_units) AS max_running_sum_total_units FROM inner_cte GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
