WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, t1.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL), DeptSpaceUnitCounts AS (SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.DLC_KEY), DeptOrgCounts AS (SELECT d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM inner_cte AS d JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON d.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON su.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY > 100000 GROUP BY d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME), RankedDeptOrg AS (SELECT doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, doc.ORGANIZATION_NAME, doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY doc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY doc.Org_SpaceUnit_Count DESC) AS OrgRank FROM DeptOrgCounts AS doc) SELECT dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, dsc.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dsc.SpaceUnit_Count, rdo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Represented_Organization, rdo.Org_SpaceUnit_Count AS Org_SpaceUnit_Count FROM DeptSpaceUnitCounts AS dsc LEFT JOIN RankedDeptOrg AS rdo ON dsc.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = rdo.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AND rdo.OrgRank = 1 ORDER BY dsc.SpaceUnit_Count DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanByDepartment AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY, EXP(AVG(LN(s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE))) AS geometric_mean FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON o.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY WHERE s.SPACE_UNIT_CODE > 0 GROUP BY o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.DLC_KEY ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC), OrganizationStats AS (SELECT d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(o.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS d JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON d.DLC_KEY = o.DLC_KEY WHERE o.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND o.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL > 4 GROUP BY d.DLC_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME, gmd.geometric_mean, os.organization_count, os.min_organization_number, gmd.DLC_KEY FROM GeometricMeanByDepartment AS gmd JOIN OrganizationStats AS os ON gmd.DLC_KEY = os.DLC_KEY AND gmd.ORGANIZATION_NAME = os.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY gmd.geometric_mean DESC, os.organization_count DESC) SELECT icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number, COUNT(DISTINCT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS total_space_units FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS s ON icte.DLC_KEY = s.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.geometric_mean, icte.organization_count, icte.min_organization_number ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean DESC, icte.organization_count DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_NUMBER, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.TOTAL_UNITS FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12), dept_avg AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_total_units FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_CODE, i.SUBJECT_NUMBER, i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, i.TOTAL_UNITS, (i.TOTAL_UNITS - d.avg_total_units) AS deviation_from_dept_avg_total_units FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME AND i.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.AREA, t0.DESCRIPTION, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1), avg_major_use AS (SELECT FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM FCLT_ROOMS WHERE ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY), subquery1 AS (SELECT i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.AREA, i.DESCRIPTION, (i.AREA - a.avg_area) AS deviation_column FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_major_use AS a ON i.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = a.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY), subquery2_base AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.FLOOR, t0.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.OFFICE_LOCATION, t1.FULL_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, t0.AREA FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS t0 JOIN EMPLOYEE_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.BUILDING_ROOM = t1.OFFICE_LOCATION WHERE t0.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = 'E38'), avg_dept_area AS (SELECT DEPARTMENT_NUMBER, AVG(AREA) AS avg_area FROM subquery2_base GROUP BY DEPARTMENT_NUMBER), subquery2 AS (SELECT s2b.BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS AREA, NULL AS DESCRIPTION, (s2b.AREA - ada.avg_area) AS deviation_column, s2b.FLOOR, s2b.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2b.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2b.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2b.FULL_NAME, s2b.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM subquery2_base AS s2b JOIN avg_dept_area AS ada ON s2b.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER = ada.DEPARTMENT_NUMBER), CombinedRooms AS (SELECT s1.BUILDING_ROOM, s1.AREA, s1.DESCRIPTION, s1.deviation_column, NULL AS FLOOR, NULL AS MAJOR_USE_DESC, NULL AS ORGANIZATION_NAME, NULL AS OFFICE_LOCATION, NULL AS FULL_NAME, NULL AS DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'AccessLevel1' AS Reason FROM subquery1 AS s1 UNION ALL SELECT s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.AREA, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.deviation_column, s2.FLOOR, s2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s2.OFFICE_LOCATION, s2.FULL_NAME, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, 'E38Rooms' AS Reason FROM subquery2 AS s2) SELECT * FROM CombinedRooms ORDER BY BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_CODE) AS subject_code_count, MIN(d.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS min_dept_budget_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s.SUBJECT_CODE), DeptCourseStats AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER, COUNT(DISTINCT l.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.SUBJECT_CODE, dss.subject_code_count, dss.min_dept_budget_code, dcs.COURSE_NUMBER, dcs.subject_count, dcs.min_total_units FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS ssc ON dss.SUBJECT_CODE = ssc.SUBJECT_CODE JOIN DeptCourseStats AS dcs ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = dcs.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.COURSE_NUMBER = dcs.COURSE_NUMBER) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, AVG(sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_num_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER = sos.COURSE_NUMBER AND inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = sos.OFFER_DEPT_NAME WHERE sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 2 GROUP BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.SUBJECT_CODE, inner_cte.subject_code_count, inner_cte.min_dept_budget_code, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC, t2.AREA FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200), org_hr AS (SELECT t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), room_org_hr AS (SELECT icte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, icte.AREA, icte.BUILDING_ROOM, icte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, icte.DLC_KEY, ohr.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, ohr.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN org_hr AS ohr ON icte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = ohr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), major_use_area AS (SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, SUM(roh.AREA) AS total_area FROM room_org_hr AS roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC), major_use_org AS (SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(*) AS org_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM room_org_hr AS roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.ORGANIZATION_NAME), major_use_hr_dept AS (SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(*) AS dept_room_count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC) AS rn FROM room_org_hr AS roh GROUP BY roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), major_use_dlc AS (SELECT roh.MAJOR_USE_DESC, roh.DLC_KEY, muo.ORGANIZATION_NAME AS Most_Common_Organization, mud.DLC_KEY, muhd.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME AS Most_Common_HR_Department, muhd.dept_room_count AS Room_Count_From_Dept FROM major_use_area AS mua LEFT JOIN major_use_org AS muo ON mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC = muo.MAJOR_USE_DESC AND muo.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN major_use_dlc AS mud ON mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC = mud.MAJOR_USE_DESC AND mud.rn = 1 LEFT JOIN major_use_hr_dept AS muhd ON mua.MAJOR_USE_DESC = muhd.MAJOR_USE_DESC AND muhd.rn = 1 ORDER BY mua.total_area DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH EngSubjects AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.TOTAL_UNITS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), SubjectEnrollmentStats AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, MAX(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY ROWS BETWEEN CURRENT ROW AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS max_enrolled_students FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.IS_MASTER_SECTION = 'Y' AND t0.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P') SELECT es.SUBJECT_TITLE, es.TOTAL_UNITS, es.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, es.window_column, ses.SUBJECT_ID, ses.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ses.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, ses.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ses.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ses.max_enrolled_students FROM EngSubjects AS es JOIN SubjectEnrollmentStats AS ses ON es.SUBJECT_TITLE = ses.SUBJECT_TITLE) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.window_column, icte.SUBJECT_ID, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.max_enrolled_students, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME AS OFFERING_DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY icte.max_enrolled_students DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS organization_count, MIN(f.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS min_organization_number FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 GROUP BY m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME), OrgSuperviseeGeomMean AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, i.organization_count, i.min_organization_number, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN OrgSuperviseeGeomMean AS o ON i.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptSubjectStats AS (SELECT c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT c.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(s.TOTAL_UNITS) AS min_total_units FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 GROUP BY c.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t.ACADEMIC_YEAR), GradStudentInfo AS (SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, t1.EMAIL_ADDRESS, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t0.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.FULL_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t0.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') SELECT dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dss.ACADEMIC_YEAR, dss.subject_count, dss.min_total_units, gsi.FULL_NAME, gsi.EMAIL_ADDRESS, gsi.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, gsi.window_column FROM DeptSubjectStats AS dss JOIN GradStudentInfo AS gsi ON dss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = gsi.DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.subject_count, inner_cte.min_total_units, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, inner_cte.EMAIL_ADDRESS, inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, inner_cte.window_column, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.TOTAL_UNITS FROM inner_cte JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t ON c.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE AND t.ACADEMIC_YEAR = inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE AND c.SUBJECT_ID = s.SUBJECT_ID WHERE s.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 10 ORDER BY inner_cte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.FULL_NAME, s.SUBJECT_TITLE

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, COUNT(s.SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY_KEY) AS subject_count, SUM(s.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND s.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND s.TERM_CODE LIKE '2021%' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME), DeptActiveGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS total_active_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT_NAME, m.DEPARTMENT HAVING COUNT(*) > 0), EECSGradStudents AS (SELECT m.DEPARTMENT, COUNT(*) AS eecs_grad_students FROM SE_PERSON AS s JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS m ON s.FULL_NAME = m.FULL_NAME WHERE s.IS_ACTIVE = 'Y' AND m.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' AND NOT m.OFFICE_LOCATION IS NULL AND m.DEPARTMENT = 6 GROUP BY m.DEPARTMENT) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE, icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.total_enrollment, dag.total_active_grad_students, COALESCE(eecs.eecs_grad_students, 0) AS eecs_grad_students FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON icte.DEPARTMENT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE LEFT JOIN DeptActiveGradStudents AS dag ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = dag.DEPARTMENT LEFT JOIN EECSGradStudents AS eecs ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = eecs.DEPARTMENT WHERE NOT dag.total_active_grad_students IS NULL AND COALESCE(eecs.eecs_grad_students, 0) >= 0.6 * dag.total_active_grad_students ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t2.TERM_PARAMETER, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.RECORD_COUNT FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'EO'), avg_per_term_param AS (SELECT atp.TERM_PARAMETER, AVG(td.RECORD_COUNT) AS avg_materials_per_subject FROM TIP_DETAIL AS td JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON td.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp ON ata.TERM_CODE = atp.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.TERM_PARAMETER <> 'SIS_UPCOMING_TERM' AND NOT ata.TERM_START_DATE IS NULL GROUP BY atp.TERM_PARAMETER) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT, avg_per_term_param.avg_materials_per_subject, (inner_cte.RECORD_COUNT - avg_per_term_param.avg_materials_per_subject) AS deviation_from_avg FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN avg_per_term_param ON inner_cte.TERM_PARAMETER = avg_per_term_param.TERM_PARAMETER ORDER BY inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering'), dept_avg AS (SELECT OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_units FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY WHERE TERM_CODE = '2014FA' GROUP BY OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column AS min_total_units_window, s2.window_column AS dense_rank_total_units_engineering, d.avg_units AS dept_avg_units, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > d.avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < d.avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON icte.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID JOIN dept_avg AS d ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = d.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME), Sub2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.subject_count, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE FROM inner_cte AS i LEFT JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON i.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME WHERE i.subject_count > (SELECT AVG(dept_subject_count) FROM (SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT t1.SUBJECT_ID) AS dept_subject_count FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.EFFECTIVE_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2006FA' GROUP BY t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME) AS sub) ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH org_geom_mean_supervisees AS (SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES))) AS geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN SPACE_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY JOIN SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE ON SPACE_UNIT.DLC_KEY = SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.DEPT_NAMES WHERE SPACE_SUPERVISOR_USAGE.NUM_OF_SUPERVISEES > 0 GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC), space_unit_info AS (SELECT t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t1.DLC_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column, o.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN org_geom_mean_supervisees AS o ON t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME = o.ORGANIZATION_NAME) SELECT s.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, s.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s.DLC_NAME, s.DLC_KEY, s.window_column, s.geometric_mean_supervisees FROM space_unit_info AS s) SELECT SPACE_UNIT_KEY, ORGANIZATION_NAME, DLC_NAME, DLC_KEY, window_column, geometric_mean_supervisees FROM inner_cte ORDER BY geometric_mean_supervisees DESC LIMIT 10

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgStats AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1), DeptStats AS (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_avg_key, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_row_number FROM OrgStats AS o JOIN DeptStats AS d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT * FROM inner_cte WHERE org_window_avg_key > (SELECT AVG(org_window_avg_key) FROM inner_cte) ORDER BY HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(h.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count, SUM(h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS total_department_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS f JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON f.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD = h.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE_OLD WHERE f.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND h.HR_DEPARTMENT_ID > 100000 GROUP BY f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, f.ORGANIZATION_NAME, h.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME), RoomDLCStats AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t2.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, t2.AREA, t2.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.DEPT_CODE, t1.DLC_KEY, MIN(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.DLC_KEY ORDER BY t1.DLC_KEY) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t1 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.BUILDING_ROOM LIKE 'E%' AND t2.AREA > 50), MajorUseCounts AS (SELECT r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC) AS unique_major_use_count FROM RoomDLCStats AS r GROUP BY r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.hr_org_unit_count, o.total_department_id, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, r.AREA, r.DEPT_CODE, r.DLC_KEY, r.window_column, m.unique_major_use_count FROM inner_cte AS o JOIN RoomDLCStats AS r ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN MajorUseCounts AS m ON o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = m.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DLC_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, t0.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, AVG(t2.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') SELECT rmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, rmd.LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, rmd.TERM_CODE, rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, rmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, rmd.window_column AS reserve_window_avg_record_count, tmd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AS textbook_material_key, tmd.SUBJECT_ID, tmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR AS textbook_academic_year, tmd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS textbook_term_description, tmd.window_column AS textbook_row_number, tmd.TERM_START_DATE AS textbook_term_start_date, tmd.TERM_END_DATE AS textbook_term_end_date FROM inner_cte AS rmd JOIN (SELECT t1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_CODE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, t0.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_CODE) AS window_column, t0.TERM_START_DATE, t0.TERM_END_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') AS tmd ON rmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY = tmd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY AND rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR = tmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY rmd.ACADEMIC_YEAR DESC, tmd.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.DLC_KEY, t1.DLC_NAME, t2.SPACE_UNIT_KEY FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.DLC_KEY = t2.DLC_KEY), OrgCounts AS (SELECT DLC_KEY, COUNT(DISTINCT FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION WHERE NOT ORGANIZATION_NAME IS NULL AND NOT DLC_KEY IS NULL GROUP BY DLC_KEY) SELECT icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT icte.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS unique_space_unit_count, MAX(oc.org_count) AS highest_org_count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN OrgCounts AS oc ON icte.DLC_KEY = oc.DLC_KEY GROUP BY icte.DLC_KEY, icte.DLC_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME ORDER BY c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY), MathematicsRowNumber AS (SELECT d.ACTIVITY_TITLE, d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, d.MAX_ENROLLMENT, c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY d.ENROLLMENT_TYPE ORDER BY d.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY WHERE c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = 'Mathematics') SELECT acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, COUNT(*) AS Total_Activities, COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS Mathematics_Activities, MAX(acdr.MAX_ENROLLMENT) AS Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, ROUND(CAST(COUNT(mrn.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS REAL) / NULLIF(COUNT(*), 0), 2) AS Mathematics_Activity_Ratio FROM ActivityCategoryDenseRank AS acdr LEFT JOIN MathematicsRowNumber AS mrn ON acdr.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = mrn.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY acdr.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio, ROUND(AVG(d.MAX_ENROLLMENT), 2) AS Avg_Max_Enrollment FROM inner_cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY AS c ON inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME = c.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS d ON d.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY = c.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.IAP_CATEGORY_NAME, inner_cte.Total_Activities, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activities, inner_cte.Max_Enrollment_Any_Activity, inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio ORDER BY inner_cte.Mathematics_Activity_Ratio DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT srf.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, srf.SUBJECT_TITLE, srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, srf.TERM_DESCRIPTION, srf.window_column, tds.subject_count FROM (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS srf JOIN (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_TITLE) AS subject_count FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lso.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE at.ACADEMIC_YEAR >= 2014 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10) AS tds ON srf.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = tds.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.subject_count, COALESCE(SUM(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS), 0) AS total_enrolled_students FROM inner_cte LEFT JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY = tso.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY GROUP BY inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.subject_count ORDER BY inner_cte.subject_count DESC, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS material_status_row_number FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), dept_info AS (SELECT tso.SUBJECT_ID, tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_CODE FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), school_counts AS (SELECT di.SCHOOL_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT di.SUBJECT_ID) AS Subject_Count FROM dept_info AS di GROUP BY di.SCHOOL_CODE), school_ranked AS (SELECT sc.SCHOOL_CODE, sc.Subject_Count, RANK() OVER (ORDER BY sc.Subject_Count DESC) AS school_rank FROM school_counts AS sc) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_ID, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, ic.TERM_CODE, ic.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, ic.ISBN, ic.material_status_row_number, di.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, di.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, sr.SCHOOL_CODE AS Most_Represented_School, sr.Subject_Count AS Subjects_From_School FROM inner_cte AS ic JOIN dept_info AS di ON ic.SUBJECT_ID = di.SUBJECT_ID JOIN school_ranked AS sr ON di.SCHOOL_CODE = sr.SCHOOL_CODE AND sr.school_rank = 1 ORDER BY ic.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10

t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.SPACE_UNIT_KEY) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), RoomsFloor2 AS (SELECT t0.BUILDING_ROOM, t0.SPACE_USAGE, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t2.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, MIN(t0.ACCESS_LEVEL) OVER (ORDER BY t0.BUILDING_COMPONENT ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.SPACE_UNIT_CODE, t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID FROM ZPM_ROOMS_LOAD AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t2 ON t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID = t2.HR_ORG_UNIT_ID WHERE t0.FLOOR = 2), CombinedResults AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.DESCRIPTION, o.SPACE_UNIT, o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, o.window_column AS org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.window_column AS room_window_column FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON o.SPACE_UNIT_KEY = su.SPACE_UNIT_KEY JOIN RoomsFloor2 AS r ON su.SPACE_UNIT_CODE = r.SPACE_UNIT_CODE) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, org_window_column, BUILDING_ROOM, SPACE_USAGE, HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, room_window_column FROM CombinedResults), RoomTotals AS (SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY, NULL AS org_window_column, NULL AS BUILDING_ROOM, NULL AS SPACE_USAGE, NULL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, NULL AS HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, NULL AS room_window_column, COUNT(*) AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte GROUP BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, DESCRIPTION, SPACE_UNIT, SPACE_UNIT_KEY) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.DESCRIPTION, i.SPACE_UNIT, i.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, i.org_window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.SPACE_USAGE, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.room_window_column, NULL AS total_rooms FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT r.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, r.DESCRIPTION, r.SPACE_UNIT, r.SPACE_UNIT_KEY, r.org_window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.SPACE_USAGE, r.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, r.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, r.room_window_column, r.total_rooms FROM RoomTotals AS r ORDER BY ORGANIZATION_NAME, SPACE_UNIT, BUILDING_ROOM
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DeptProvostArea AS (SELECT m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, COUNT(f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_count, MIN(m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_CODE) AS min_level3_code FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS m JOIN FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS f ON m.DLC_KEY = f.DLC_KEY WHERE m.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' GROUP BY m.DLC_NAME, f.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), RoomAreaWindow AS (SELECT t2.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.DLC_KEY, SUM(t2.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC ORDER BY t2.BUILDING_ROOM) AS window_column, t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t2.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM FCLT_ORG_DLC_KEY AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t2 ON t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = t2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE t2.AREA > 200) SELECT dpa.DLC_NAME, dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, dpa.org_count, dpa.min_level3_code, raw.BUILDING_ROOM, raw.ORGANIZATION_NAME, raw.DLC_KEY, raw.window_column, ROUND(CAST(raw.window_column AS REAL) / NULLIF(dpa.org_count, 0), 2) AS window_per_org, raw.MAJOR_USE_DESC FROM DeptProvostArea AS dpa JOIN RoomAreaWindow AS raw ON dpa.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = raw.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), avg_window_per_group AS (SELECT MAJOR_USE_DESC, AVG(window_column) AS avg_window FROM inner_cte GROUP BY MAJOR_USE_DESC) SELECT i.DLC_NAME, i.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, i.org_count, i.min_level3_code, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.DLC_KEY, i.window_column, i.window_per_org FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN avg_window_per_group AS a ON i.MAJOR_USE_DESC = a.MAJOR_USE_DESC WHERE i.window_column > a.avg_window ORDER BY i.window_per_org DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), DeptEnrolledStudents AS (SELECT l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrolled FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON l.SUBJECT_ID = t.SUBJECT_ID WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' GROUP BY l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING SUM(l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 10), CombinedDeptInfo AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, d.course_count, d.min_cip_code, s.total_enrolled FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS d JOIN DeptEnrolledStudents AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT * FROM CombinedDeptInfo), avg_enrollment AS (SELECT AVG(total_enrolled) AS avg_total_enrolled FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrolled, CASE WHEN i.total_enrolled > a.avg_total_enrolled * 1.2 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN i.total_enrolled < a.avg_total_enrolled * 0.8 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte AS i CROSS JOIN avg_enrollment AS a ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment AS (SELECT s.DEPARTMENT_NAME, SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS total_enrollment FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS s JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t ON s.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN STUDENT_DEPARTMENT AS d ON t.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE s.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' GROUP BY s.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING SUM(t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) > 50) SELECT dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME, dgc.SCHOOL_NAME, dgc.course_count, dgc.min_cip_code, ede.total_enrollment FROM DegreeGrantingDeptCourses AS dgc JOIN EngineeringDeptHighEnrollment AS ede ON dgc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ede.DEPARTMENT_NAME), min_cip_avg AS (SELECT AVG(min_cip_code) AS avg_min_cip_code FROM inner_cte) SELECT i.DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.SCHOOL_NAME, i.course_count, i.min_cip_code, i.total_enrollment FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN min_cip_avg AS a ON i.min_cip_code < a.avg_min_cip_code ORDER BY i.DEPARTMENT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH TopSubjects AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE, COUNT(lrmd.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrmd ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = lrmd.SUBJECT_ID GROUP BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY num_reserve_materials DESC LIMIT 10), PreviousTerms AS (SELECT t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FINANCIAL_AID_YEAR ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS window_column FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY = t1.ACADEMIC_TERMS_KEY WHERE t0.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous') SELECT ts.SUBJECT_TITLE, ts.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, ts.TERM_CODE, pt.TERM_DESCRIPTION, pt.ACADEMIC_YEAR, pt.window_column, ts.num_reserve_materials FROM TopSubjects AS ts JOIN PreviousTerms AS pt ON ts.TERM_CODE = pt.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.window_column, inner_cte.num_reserve_materials, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, ata.LAST_DAY_OF_FINAL_EXAM FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t1.ISBN, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t0.SUBJECT_ID) AS window_column, t2.TERM_DESCRIPTION FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID = t1.SUBJECT_ID JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t2 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 5), IAP_Activities AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 12), IAP_Totals AS (SELECT NULL AS SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, NULL AS window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, TERM_DESCRIPTION, COUNT(*) AS total_activities, 'IAPActivityTotal' AS Source FROM IAP_Activities GROUP BY TERM_DESCRIPTION) SELECT i.SUBJECT_ID, i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, i.TERM_CODE, i.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, i.ISBN, i.window_column, NULL AS ACTIVITY_TITLE, NULL AS ENROLLMENT_TYPE, i.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS total_activities, 'LibrarySubject' AS Source FROM inner_cte AS i UNION ALL SELECT a.SUBJECT_ID, NULL AS SUBJECT_TITLE, NULL AS NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, NULL AS TERM_CODE, NULL AS TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, NULL AS ISBN, a.window_column, a.ACTIVITY_TITLE, a.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, a.TERM_DESCRIPTION, NULL AS total_activities, 'IAPActivity' AS Source FROM IAP_Activities AS a UNION ALL SELECT t.SUBJECT_ID, t.SUBJECT_TITLE, t.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t.TERM_CODE, t.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, t.ISBN, t.window_column, t.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t.total_activities, t.Source FROM IAP_Totals AS t ORDER BY TERM_DESCRIPTION, Source, SUBJECT_ID
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, d.SCHOOL_NAME), SubjectSummary AS (SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.TERM_CODE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.SUBJECT_CODE WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2022FA' AND t0.TOTAL_UNITS = 12) SELECT icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, icte.SCHOOL_NAME, icte.course_count, icte.min_cip_code, ss.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccso.SUBJECT_SHORT_TITLE, ccso.GRADE_TYPE_DESC, ss.window_column FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectSummary AS ss ON icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME = ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON ss.SUBJECT_CODE = ccso.SUBJECT_CODE AND ss.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE ORDER BY icte.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ss.window_column
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Sub1 AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, lso.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, MIN(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) OVER (ORDER BY sos.COURSE_NUMBER ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS join_dept_name FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Sub2 AS (SELECT ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS max_enrollment, at.TERM_START_DATE FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON atp.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON at.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' GROUP BY ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, at.TERM_START_DATE HAVING MAX(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) > 5) SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.window_column, s2.max_enrollment, s2.TERM_START_DATE, s1.join_dept_name FROM Sub1 AS s1 JOIN Sub2 AS s2 ON s1.join_dept_name = s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME), dept_avg AS (SELECT lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, AVG(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS dept_avg_units FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.TERM_CODE = '2014FA' AND lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY lso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.SUBJECT_TITLE, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME, icte.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, icte.TOTAL_UNITS, icte.window_column, icte.max_enrollment, icte.TERM_START_DATE, davg.dept_avg_units AS department_avg_units, CASE WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS > davg.dept_avg_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN icte.TOTAL_UNITS < davg.dept_avg_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_classification FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN dept_avg AS davg ON icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = davg.OFFER_DEPT_NAME
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT s.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s.SUBJECT_TITLE, s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s.window_column AS subject_rank_in_dept, l.COURSE_NUMBER, l.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, l.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, l.window_column AS dense_rank_material_status, s.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t0.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025') AS s JOIN (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U') AS l ON s.SUBJECT_ID = l.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_TITLE, inner_cte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, inner_cte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.subject_rank_in_dept, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER, inner_cte.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, inner_cte.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, inner_cte.dense_rank_material_status, inner_cte.RESPONSIBLE_FACULTY_NAME FROM inner_cte ORDER BY inner_cte.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS DESC LIMIT 10
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(r.FCLT_ROOM_KEY) AS room_count, MIN(r.FLOOR) AS min_floor, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS r JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS o ON r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE r.AREA > 100 AND r.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 GROUP BY r.MAJOR_USE_DESC, o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, r.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT s1.MAJOR_USE_DESC, s1.ORGANIZATION_NAME, s1.room_count, s1.min_floor, s2.BUILDING_ROOM, s2.FLOOR, s2.ROOM, s2.SPACE_ID, s2.AREA, s2.MAJOR_USE, s2.DESCRIPTION, s2.min_area_per_major_use, s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = s2.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY AND s1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = s2.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.room_count, inner_cte.min_floor, inner_cte.BUILDING_ROOM, inner_cte.FLOOR, inner_cte.ROOM, inner_cte.SPACE_ID, inner_cte.AREA, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE, inner_cte.DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.min_area_per_major_use, fo.DESCRIPTION AS ORGANIZATION_DESCRIPTION FROM inner_cte JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON inner_cte.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY inner_cte.MAJOR_USE_DESC, inner_cte.ORGANIZATION_NAME, inner_cte.MAJOR_USE
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT lso.SUBJECT_TITLE, lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, lso.TERM_CODE, td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, sos.TOTAL_UNITS, AVG(lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY lso.SUBJECT_TITLE ORDER BY sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS avg_enrolled_students, lso.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS lso INNER JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON lso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID INNER JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON td.SUBJECT_ID = sos.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0), Subq2 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t2.SUBJECT_ID, t0.SCHOOL_CODE, t0.SCHOOL_NAME FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS t1 ON t0.COURSE_NUMBER = t1.COURSE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.COURSE = t2.COURSE_NUMBER WHERE t2.TERM_CODE = '2016SP' AND t0.SCHOOL_CODE = 'E') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.TERM_CODE, s1.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY, s1.TOTAL_UNITS, s1.avg_enrolled_students, s2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, s2.COURSE_DESCRIPTION, s2.window_column, s2.SCHOOL_NAME FROM inner_cte AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID ORDER BY s1.TOTAL_UNITS DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subq1 AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY) AS window_column, t0.SUBJECT_ID FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION = 'Fall Term 2024-2025'), Subq2 AS (SELECT t1.COURSE_NUMBER, t1.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY ORDER BY t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID FROM LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID = t2.SUBJECT_ID WHERE t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND t2.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U'), CombinedSubjects AS (SELECT s1.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, s1.window_column AS dept_rank, s2.COURSE_NUMBER, s2.COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s2.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, s2.window_column AS material_status_rank FROM Subq1 AS s1 JOIN Subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_ID = s2.SUBJECT_ID) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank FROM CombinedSubjects) SELECT TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, SUBJECT_TITLE, OFFER_DEPT_NAME, TERM_DESCRIPTION, dept_rank, COURSE_NUMBER, COURSE_NUMBER_DESC, NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY, material_status_rank, CASE WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS >= 10 THEN 'HIGH_ENROLLMENT' WHEN NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 2 THEN 'LOW_ENROLLMENT' ELSE 'MEDIUM_ENROLLMENT' END AS enrollment_category FROM inner_cte ORDER BY TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, COURSE_NUMBER

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH IAPActivities AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t0.PREREQUISITES, t0.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t1.TERM_END_DATE, MIN(t1.TERM_START_DATE) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.TERM_CODE ORDER BY t0.TERM_CODE) AS window_column FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30), TipRQDetails AS (SELECT t0.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, t0.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, t0.SUBJECT_ID, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR, AVG(t0.RECORD_COUNT) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t0.TERM_CODE FROM TIP_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ') SELECT ia.ACTIVITY_TITLE, ia.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, ia.PREREQUISITES, ia.TERM_CODE, ia.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, ia.TERM_START_DATE, ia.TERM_END_DATE, ia.window_column AS IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, trd.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, trd.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, trd.SUBJECT_ID, trd.TERM_DESCRIPTION AS TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, trd.ACADEMIC_YEAR, trd.window_column AS TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT FROM IAPActivities AS ia JOIN TipRQDetails AS trd ON ia.TERM_CODE = trd.TERM_CODE) SELECT inner_cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, inner_cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, inner_cte.PREREQUISITES, inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.IAP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TERM_END_DATE, inner_cte.IAP_MIN_TERM_START_DATE, inner_cte.TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED_KEY, inner_cte.TIP_MATERIAL_KEY, inner_cte.SUBJECT_ID, inner_cte.TIP_TERM_DESCRIPTION, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, inner_cte.TIP_AVG_RECORD_COUNT, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC FROM inner_cte JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON inner_cte.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE ORDER BY inner_cte.TERM_CODE, inner_cte.ACADEMIC_YEAR
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH Subquery1 AS (SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = t2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND t0.CLUSTER_TYPE = 'S'), Subquery2 AS (SELECT so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(so.SUBJECT_KEY) AS offering_count, SUM(sos.TOTAL_UNITS) AS total_units, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so ON sos.SUBJECT_ID = so.SUBJECT_ID JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON so.SUBJECT_ID = ss.SUBJECT_ID WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2012SU' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' GROUP BY so.SUBJECT_KEY, so.SUBJECT_TITLE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, so.SUBJECT_ID_SORT) SELECT sq2.SUBJECT_KEY, sq2.SUBJECT_TITLE, sq2.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sq2.offering_count, sq2.total_units, sq1.window_column, sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT FROM Subquery2 AS sq2 JOIN Subquery1 AS sq1 ON sq2.SUBJECT_ID_SORT = sq1.SUBJECT_ID_SORT), unit_benchmark AS (SELECT AVG(total_units) AS avg_total_units FROM inner_cte) SELECT ic.SUBJECT_KEY, ic.SUBJECT_TITLE, ic.DEPARTMENT_NAME, ic.offering_count, ic.total_units, ic.window_column, CASE WHEN ic.total_units > ub.avg_total_units * 1.1 THEN 'HIGH_UNIT' WHEN ic.total_units < ub.avg_total_units * 0.9 THEN 'LOW_UNIT' ELSE 'AVERAGE' END AS unit_category FROM inner_cte AS ic CROSS JOIN unit_benchmark AS ub ORDER BY ic.total_units DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH OrgLevel5 AS (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID, t1.DLC_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME) AS window_column, t0.DLC_KEY, t0.ORGANIZATION_ID AS org_id FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5), LargeAssignableRooms AS (SELECT t1.BUILDING_ROOM, t1.FLOOR, t1.ROOM, t1.SPACE_ID, t1.AREA, t0.MAJOR_USE, t0.DESCRIPTION, MIN(t1.AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY ORDER BY t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY) AS min_area_per_major_use, t1.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY FROM FCLT_MAJOR_USE AS t0 JOIN FCLT_ROOMS AS t1 ON t0.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY = t1.FCLT_MAJOR_USE_KEY WHERE t1.AREA > 200 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.ORGANIZATION_ID, o.DLC_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, o.window_column, r.BUILDING_ROOM, r.FLOOR, r.ROOM, r.SPACE_ID, r.AREA, r.MAJOR_USE, r.DESCRIPTION, r.min_area_per_major_use, o.DLC_KEY FROM OrgLevel5 AS o JOIN LargeAssignableRooms AS r ON o.ORGANIZATION_ID = r.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) SELECT i.ORGANIZATION_NAME, i.ORGANIZATION_ID, i.DLC_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE, i.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, i.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL, i.window_column, i.BUILDING_ROOM, i.FLOOR, i.ROOM, i.SPACE_ID, i.AREA, i.MAJOR_USE, i.DESCRIPTION, i.min_area_per_major_use, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE AS HR_ORG_UNIT_TITLE_FROM_HR, h.HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL AS HR_ORG_UNIT_LEVEL_FROM_HR FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS h ON i.DLC_KEY = h.DLC_KEY

WITH inner_cte AS (WITH subq1 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, MIN(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 3 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column, t1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE WHERE t1.TERM_CODE = '2012SU'), subq2 AS (SELECT t1.SUBJECT_KEY, t1.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR, SUM(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t1.SUBJECT_KEY) AS running_enrollment_sum, t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t2.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives') SELECT s1.SUBJECT_TITLE, s1.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, s1.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, s1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, s1.window_column, s2.ACADEMIC_YEAR, s2.running_enrollment_sum, s2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, s2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, s1.SUBJECT_KEY FROM subq1 AS s1 JOIN subq2 AS s2 ON s1.SUBJECT_KEY = s2.SUBJECT_KEY ORDER BY s2.running_enrollment_sum DESC LIMIT 10), dept_avg AS (SELECT t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, AVG(t1.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled_students FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t1 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS t0 ON t1.TERM_CODE = t0.TERM_CODE WHERE t0.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2012 AND t1.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC = 'SWE: School-Wide Electives' GROUP BY t1.OFFER_DEPT_CODE) SELECT i.SUBJECT_TITLE, i.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, i.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, i.CLUSTER_TYPE_DESC, i.window_column, i.ACADEMIC_YEAR, i.running_enrollment_sum, (i.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS - d.avg_enrolled_students) AS deviation_from_dept_avg FROM inner_cte AS i JOIN dept_avg AS d ON i.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = d.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY i.running_enrollment_sum DESC
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t1.TERM_CODE, t1.TERM_DESCRIPTION, t1.TERM_START_DATE, t0.CALENDAR_DATE, t0.DAY_OF_WEEK, AVG(t0.CALENDAR_YEAR) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.CALENDAR_YEAR ORDER BY t1.TERM_START_DATE) AS window_column FROM TIME_DAY AS t0 JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t1 ON t0.CALENDAR_DATE = t1.TERM_START_DATE WHERE t1.TERM_STATUS = 'Previous'), SubjectCategoryStats AS (SELECT i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, COUNT(DISTINCT i.IAP_SUBJECT_SESSION_KEY) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_term_start_date FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS a ON i.TERM_CODE = a.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE WHERE i.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 10 GROUP BY i.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, a.ACADEMIC_YEAR), TermSubjectInfo AS (SELECT t.TERM_CODE, COUNT(DISTINCT td.SUBJECT_ID) AS unique_subject_ids, MIN(i.PREREG_DEADLINE) AS earliest_prereg_deadline FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS AS t JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON t.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS i ON t.TERM_CODE = i.TERM_CODE GROUP BY t.TERM_CODE) SELECT icte.TERM_CODE, icte.TERM_DESCRIPTION, icte.TERM_START_DATE, icte.CALENDAR_DATE, icte.DAY_OF_WEEK, icte.window_column, scs.IAP_SUBJECT_CATEGORY_KEY, scs.ACADEMIC_YEAR, scs.subject_count, scs.min_term_start_date, ROUND(CAST(scs.subject_count AS REAL) / NULLIF(icte.window_column, 0), 2) AS Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year, tsi.unique_subject_ids, tsi.earliest_prereg_deadline FROM inner_cte AS icte JOIN SubjectCategoryStats AS scs ON icte.TERM_START_DATE = scs.min_term_start_date JOIN TermSubjectInfo AS tsi ON icte.TERM_CODE = tsi.TERM_CODE ORDER BY Normalized_Subjects_Per_Year DESC

WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT o.ORGANIZATION_NAME, o.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, o.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, o.window_column AS org_window_column, d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, d.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, d.window_column AS dept_window_row_number FROM (SELECT t0.ORGANIZATION_NAME, t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS window_column FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t0.ORGANIZATION_LEVEL = 5 AND t0.ASSIGNABLE = 1) AS o JOIN (SELECT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, t0.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS t0 JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT AS t1 ON t0.DLC_KEY = t1.DLC_KEY WHERE t1.ORG_HIER_TOP_LEVEL_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND NOT t1.HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE IS NULL) AS d ON o.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = d.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME) SELECT ORGANIZATION_NAME, FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME, HR_DEPARTMENT_CODE, org_window_column, HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG, MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_3_NAME, dept_window_row_number FROM inner_cte WHERE LOWER(HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME_LONG) LIKE '%science%'
WITH inner_cte AS (SELECT t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE, t0.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, t1.CALENDAR_DATE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY t0.ACTIVITY_TITLE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 1 FOLLOWING) AS row_number_window FROM IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS t0 JOIN TIME_DAY AS t1 ON t0.TERM_CODE = t1.ACADEMIC_TERM_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2021JA' AND t0.IS_CANCELLED = 'N' AND t0.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30) SELECT cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE, cte.ENROLLMENT_TYPE, cte.CALENDAR_DATE, cte.row_number_window, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY at.ACADEMIC_YEAR ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS dense_rank_window, CASE WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT = 30 THEN 'FULL' WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT < 30 THEN 'LIMITED' WHEN isd.MAX_ENROLLMENT > 30 THEN 'UNLIMITED' ELSE 'UNKNOWN' END AS enrollment_status FROM inner_cte AS cte JOIN IAP_SUBJECT_DETAIL AS isd ON cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE = isd.ACTIVITY_TITLE JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON isd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE ORDER BY cte.ACTIVITY_TITLE
WITH inner_cte AS (WITH GeometricMeanEnrollment AS (SELECT ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS))) AS geometric_mean_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED ON ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.TERM_CODE = LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.TERM_CODE WHERE LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 GROUP BY ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY geometric_mean_enrollment DESC), SubjectCountMinStartDate AS (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, MIN(a.TERM_START_DATE) AS min_start_date FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON a.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, scmsd.subject_count, scmsd.min_start_date FROM GeometricMeanEnrollment AS gme JOIN SubjectCountMinStartDate AS scmsd ON gme.ACADEMIC_YEAR = scmsd.ACADEMIC_YEAR ORDER BY gme.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, scmsd.OFFER_DEPT_NAME) SELECT icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR, icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, icte.geometric_mean_enrollment, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, icte.subject_count, icte.min_start_date, ssc.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME AS Most_Prominent_School, ssc.School_Subject_Count FROM inner_cte AS icte LEFT JOIN (SELECT a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) AS School_Subject_Count, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME ORDER BY COUNT(DISTINCT l.SUBJECT_ID) DESC) AS rn FROM ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS a JOIN LIBRARY_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS l ON a.TERM_CODE = l.TERM_CODE WHERE l.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 5 GROUP BY a.ACADEMIC_YEAR, l.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, l.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME) AS ssc ON icte.ACADEMIC_YEAR = ssc.ACADEMIC_YEAR AND icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = ssc.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AND ssc.rn = 1 ORDER BY icte.geometric_mean_enrollment DESC, icte.OFFER_DEPT_NAME

SELECT tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME AS department_name, COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) AS total_reserved_materials FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON tso.SUBJECT_ID = td.SUBJECT_ID JOIN LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrm ON td.SUBJECT_ID = lrm.SUBJECT_ID WHERE tso.OFFER_SCHOOL_NAME IN ('Engineering', 'Science') AND tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND tso.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' GROUP BY tso.OFFER_DEPT_NAME HAVING COUNT(DISTINCT lrm.LIBRARY_RESERVE_CATALOG_KEY) > 10
SELECT fr.AREA, fr.FCLT_ROOM_KEY, fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY) AS org_dense_rank FROM FCLT_ROOMS AS fr JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = fo.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fr.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY = su.FCLT_ORGANIZATION_KEY WHERE fr.AREA > 50 AND fr.ACCESS_LEVEL = 1 AND fr.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = '32' AND NOT fo.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('CAMBRIDGE-MIT INST')
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS min_num_enrolled_students, AVG(sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE) AS avg_dept_budget_code FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND ((tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS BETWEEN 1 AND 10) OR (sd.DEPT_BUDGET_CODE >= 90000)) GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE
SELECT fb.BUILDING_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT fba.POSTAL_CODE) AS num_unique_postal_codes FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_ADDRESS AS fba ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fba.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' GROUP BY fb.BUILDING_NAME ORDER BY num_unique_postal_codes DESC, fb.BUILDING_NAME LIMIT 10
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, tso.SUBJECT_TITLE, tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS AS MAX_NUM_ENROLLED FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND tso.TERM_CODE = '2019FA' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS = (SELECT MAX(tso2.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso2 WHERE tso2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE AND tso2.TERM_CODE = '2019FA') AND tso.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 10
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, c.SUBJECT_CODE FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS c ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = c.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON c.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = '2008' AND d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '15' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.SUBJECT_CODE HAVING MAX(c.TOTAL_UNITS) > 0
SELECT sp.MIT_ID, sp.FULL_NAME, msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, msd.STUDENT_YEAR, SUM(sp.MIT_ID) OVER (PARTITION BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR ORDER BY sp.MIT_ID) AS running_sum_mit_id FROM SE_PERSON AS sp JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd ON sp.FULL_NAME = msd.FULL_NAME WHERE sp.EMPLOYEE_TYPE = 'Student' AND msd.DEPARTMENT = 6 AND msd.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' ORDER BY msd.STUDENT_YEAR, sp.MIT_ID

SELECT msd.DEPARTMENT AS DEPARTMENT_CODE, MIN(sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE) AS MIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE, AVG(CASE WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G' THEN 5 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '4' THEN 4 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '3' THEN 3 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '2' THEN 2 WHEN msd.STUDENT_YEAR = '1' THEN 1 ELSE NULL END) AS AVG_STUDENT_YEAR_NUMERIC FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE (sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '6' OR sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '15' OR msd.STUDENT_YEAR = 'G') AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Economics' GROUP BY msd.DEPARTMENT

SELECT ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC, EXP(AVG(LN(ss.TOTAL_UNITS))) AS geometric_mean_total_units FROM SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON ss.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE WHERE ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND ss.TOTAL_UNITS > 0 AND ata.TERM_STATUS_INDICATOR = 'P' GROUP BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR, ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR_DESC ORDER BY ata.ACADEMIC_YEAR
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT msd.FULL_NAME) AS unique_students FROM MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS msd JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd ON msd.DEPARTMENT = sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = sos.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sos.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS > 0 AND msd.FIRST_NAME = 'Zoe' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '17' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY unique_students DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SUBJECT_CODE, t2.SUBJECT_CODE_DESC, MIN(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE) AS window_column FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.IS_NO_COURSE_MATERIAL = 'N' ORDER BY t2.SUBJECT_CODE
SELECT fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fb.BUILDING_NAME, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD, SUM(fbh.ASSIGNABLE_AREA) OVER (PARTITION BY fb.CAMPUS_SECTOR ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD ROWS BETWEEN UNBOUNDED PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS running_assignable_area FROM FCLT_BUILDING AS fb JOIN FCLT_BUILDING_HIST AS fbh ON fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY = fbh.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY WHERE fb.BUILDING_TYPE = 'ACADEMIC' AND fb.SITE = 'MIT' AND fb.OWNERSHIP_TYPE = 'OWNED' AND fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY <> '32' ORDER BY fb.FCLT_BUILDING_KEY, fbh.FISCAL_PERIOD

SELECT t2.SUBJECT_TITLE, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t2.TOTAL_UNITS ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t2.OFFER_DEPT_CODE WHERE t1.SCHOOL_NAME = 'Engineering' AND t1.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'

SELECT mdh.DLC_NAME AS department, MAX(fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER) AS max_organization_number, su.SPACE_UNIT AS space_unit_name FROM MASTER_DEPT_HIERARCHY AS mdh JOIN FCLT_ORGANIZATION AS fo ON mdh.DLC_KEY = fo.DLC_KEY LEFT JOIN SPACE_UNIT AS su ON fo.DLC_KEY = su.DLC_KEY WHERE mdh.MASTER_DEPT_HIER_LEVEL_2_NAME = 'Provost Area' AND fo.ORGANIZATION_NUMBER > 50000 AND mdh.DLC_NAME <> 'Political Science' GROUP BY mdh.DLC_NAME, su.SPACE_UNIT ORDER BY mdh.DLC_NAME
SELECT t1.FIRST_NAME, t1.LAST_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME, t1.STUDENT_YEAR, t0.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME, AVG(t2.DEPARTMENT_PHONE_NUMBER) OVER (PARTITION BY t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY t1.FIRST_NAME ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND 2 FOLLOWING) AS window_column FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t2 ON t1.DEPARTMENT = t2.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci'
SELECT ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ss.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count, SUM(ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER) AS total_enrollment FROM ACADEMIC_TERM_PARAMETER AS atp JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS_ALL AS ata ON atp.TERM_CODE = ata.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_SUMMARY AS ss ON ata.TERM_CODE = ss.TERM_CODE WHERE atp.IS_CURRENT_TERM = 'Y' AND ss.SUBJECT_ENROLLMENT_NUMBER > 0 AND ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '17' GROUP BY ata.TERM_CODE, ata.TERM_DESCRIPTION, ata.TERM_START_DATE, ss.DEPARTMENT_CODE, ss.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, COUNT(s.FULL_NAME) AS student_count, COUNT(DISTINCT s.STUDENT_YEAR) AS unique_student_years FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_CODE, d.DEPARTMENT_NAME
SELECT cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS max_total_units, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS cso JOIN CIS_COURSE_CATALOG AS ccc ON cso.SUBJECT_ID = ccc.SUBJECT_ID WHERE cso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' GROUP BY cso.SUBJECT_TITLE, ccc.DEPARTMENT_NAME HAVING MAX(cso.TOTAL_UNITS) > 6
SELECT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME, COUNT(HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_ORG_UNIT_KEY) AS hr_org_unit_count FROM FCLT_ORGANIZATION JOIN HR_ORG_UNIT ON FCLT_ORGANIZATION.DLC_KEY = HR_ORG_UNIT.DLC_KEY WHERE FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ASSIGNABLE = 1 AND NOT HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME IS NULL AND HR_ORG_UNIT.HR_DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science' AND NOT FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME IN ('ADMISSIONS', 'ANTHROPOLOGY') GROUP BY FCLT_ORGANIZATION.ORGANIZATION_NAME ORDER BY hr_org_unit_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, EXP(AVG(LN(a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR))) AS geometric_mean FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d JOIN SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS a ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = a.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE a.CLEARING_COST_COLLECTOR > 0 AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME ORDER BY geometric_mean DESC
SELECT MIN(at.ACADEMIC_YEAR) AS min_academic_year, SUM(ccso.TOTAL_UNITS) AS sum_total_units FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS lrd JOIN ACADEMIC_TERMS AS at ON lrd.TERM_CODE = at.TERM_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON at.TERM_CODE = ccso.TERM_CODE AND lrd.SUBJECT_ID = ccso.SUBJECT_ID WHERE lrd.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND ccso.IS_OFFERED_FALL_TERM = 'Y' AND ccso.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics'
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME, COUNT(DISTINCT ccso.SUBJECT_ID) AS subject_count FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS tso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = tso.OFFER_DEPT_CODE JOIN COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS ccso ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = ccso.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE ccso.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE <> '8' GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.SCHOOL_NAME ORDER BY subject_count DESC LIMIT 10
SELECT MIN(sd.ROOM_SQUARE_FOOTAGE) AS min_square_footage, SUM(sd.ROOM_COUNTER) AS total_rooms FROM SPACE_DETAIL AS sd JOIN SPACE_USAGE AS su ON sd.SPACE_USAGE_KEY = su.SPACE_USAGE_KEY WHERE su.SPACE_USAGE = 'RESEARCH CENTER' AND sd.BUILDING_KEY = 32
SELECT sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, MAX(scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS MAX_CIP_PROGRAM_CODE, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME FROM SIS_DEPARTMENT AS sd JOIN SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS scd ON sd.DEPARTMENT_CODE = scd.DEPARTMENT WHERE sd.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME <> 'Mathematics' AND scd.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE > 120000 GROUP BY sd.DEPARTMENT_NAME, sd.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME
SELECT t0.SUBJECT_TITLE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE, t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME, t1.DEPARTMENT_FULL_NAME, AVG(t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) OVER (PARTITION BY t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE ORDER BY t0.NUM_ENROLLED_STUDENTS) AS avg_enrolled FROM TIP_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS t0 JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS t1 ON t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE t0.TERM_CODE = '2017JA' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND t0.OFFER_DEPT_CODE = '5'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS harvard_cross_enrollment_subjects_with_required_materials FROM SUBJECT_OFFERED AS so JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS sos ON so.TERM_CODE = sos.TERM_CODE JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS td ON sos.TERM_CODE = td.TERM_CODE WHERE so.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND so.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Chemistry' AND td.TIP_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'RQ'
SELECT t1.FULL_NAME, DENSE_RANK() OVER (ORDER BY t1.OFFICE_PHONE ROWS BETWEEN 2 PRECEDING AND CURRENT ROW) AS window_column FROM SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT AS t0 JOIN MIT_STUDENT_DIRECTORY AS t1 ON t0.SIS_ADMIN_DEPARTMENT_CODE = t1.DEPARTMENT WHERE t1.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Electrical Eng & Computer Sci' AND t1.DEPARTMENT = '6' AND t1.FIRST_NAME = 'Kevin'
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_reserve_materials FROM LIBRARY_RESERVE_MATRL_DETAIL AS l JOIN TIP_DETAIL AS t ON l.TERM_CODE = t.TERM_CODE JOIN SUBJECT_OFFERED_SUMMARY AS s ON t.TERM_CODE = s.TERM_CODE WHERE l.TERM_CODE = '2017FA' AND l.LIBRARY_MATERIAL_STATUS_KEY = 'U' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME = 'Harvard Cross-Enrollment Prog' AND s.OFFER_DEPT_NAME IN ('Chemistry', 'Biology')
SELECT d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL, COUNT(DISTINCT c.COURSE) AS course_count, MIN(c.CIP_PROGRAM_CODE) AS min_cip_code FROM SIS_COURSE_DESCRIPTION AS c JOIN SIS_DEPARTMENT AS d ON c.DEPARTMENT = d.DEPARTMENT_CODE JOIN SIS_SUBJECT_CODE AS s ON d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = s.DEPARTMENT_CODE WHERE d.IS_DEGREE_GRANTING = 'Y' AND d.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Mathematics' AND d.DEPARTMENT_CODE = '18' GROUP BY d.DEPARTMENT_NAME, c.COURSE_LEVEL
SELECT COUNT(*) AS num_hass_elective_subjects FROM COURSE_CATALOG_SUBJECT_OFFERED AS c JOIN CIS_HASS_ATTRIBUTE AS h ON c.HASS_ATTRIBUTE = h.HASS_ATTRIBUTE WHERE c.ACADEMIC_YEAR = 2022 AND h.DESCRIPTION_ON_FORM = 'HASS Elective' AND c.DEPARTMENT_NAME = 'Political Science'
